title: The best senior Google Ads Specialist on OnlineJobs.ph
description:
We are a Danish marketing agency specializing in Google Ads for Danish and international clients. Our portfolio is roughly split between lead-generation and ecommerce, and we are building toward becoming the best lead-gen Google Ads agency in Denmark with plans to scale internationally.



We work with accounts spending between $600/month and $20,000/month today, and we expect to onboard accounts spending $50,000 to $100,000/month in the near future. You shall not be afraid of accounts at that scale.



We already have 2 Filipino tea
mbers, so you would not be the first.



We are looking at the BEST Google Ads specialists OnlineJobs.ph has to offer. If you are top 1-5% of your field, please read on. If you are a generalist who also does Google Ads on the side, please skip this post, lets save each others time. This is a senior-level, narrow-specialist role.



We work in both Danish and English. You do NOT need to speak Danish, but you must be sharp enough to BUILD SYSTEMS using AI tools that let you do keyword research, search term analysis, and ad copy review across languages you do not personally speak.





THE NARROW FOCUS:



We do NOT need Meta Ads,
 marketing, SEO, social media, web design, content writing, or full-stack digital marketing. The less you do besides Google Ads, the better fit you are. We already have a web designer, I have a VA, and I have a general marketing guy for the rest.



We need someone uncompromisingly sharp at Google Ads and only Google Ads. We do not train you in Google Ads. We expect you to know it 100% from day one and to challenge me (Rasmus) when you think I am wrong. If you can only answer Google Ads questions by asking an AI, you are not the right fit. AI is your augmentation, not your fundament.





THE VISION FOR THIS ROLE:



In the beginning, I (Rasmus) will build account strategy together with you. Over time you take on more accounts independently and eventually own direct client contact. I will handle less and less of the day-to-day so I can focus on scaling the company, optimizing our Google Ads workflows, and expanding our automation systems.



The goal is for you to grow into a role where you:



- Talk directly with German (our web developer) to brief and build relevant landing pages for your accounts

- Set up offline conversion tracking (WhatConverts integrated with each client's CRM)

- Manage Google Ads 100% on your own, making the right decisions and able to articulate WHY for each one

- Log every account action as a hypothesis in our internal AI cockpit (we track what worked, what did not, and why, so that we later have a backlog of we did this, it worked, why/why not)

- Help me develop more internal tools that speed up our processes

- Spot bottlenecks across our workflow and propose fixes

- Keep a finger on the pulse of the industry (LinkedIn, podcasts, whatever your channel is) and bring new ideas in, especially around AI, the Google Ads API, and the way Google Ads is evolving

- Tell the team, when we're wasting our time, and could do something better with our time

- Feel uncomfortable whenever you're wasting time, or could optimize a proces further



I need someone who is not falling behind. AI, the Google Ads API, and the Google Ads platform itself are all moving extremely fast in 2026. Standing still equals falling backward.



The right person grows into a true partner on the Google Ads side of the business.





HOW WE WORK (philosophy):



We automate audits, account management, monitoring alerts, and reporting. Not primarily to make things faster, but to INCREASE the quality every client receives. Quality first, speed second.



We work extensively through the Google Ads API and expect you to grow into that work too. We track profit (not just ROAS) for every client we can. Profit is the north star.





ABOUT YOUR ACCOUNTS:



You will manage between 10 and 30 client accounts depending on size. Smaller accounts may only need a few hours per month. Larger accounts will need 10+ hours per month. You schedule your own time, manage your own deadlines, and proactively tell us when you need more hours allocated to deliver quality work. We do NOT chase you. You own your portfolio, and I need someone I can trust, so I never have to checkup. If I need to check up, then you're no the right person. You'll get a few accounts to test on in the beginning as we onboard, then slowly a bigger and bigger part of the portfolio.





Tasks and responsibilities:



- Own 10 to 30 client accounts across lead-gen and ecommerce (execution, optimization, reporting)

- Build and refine campaigns (Search, Performance Max, Shopping)

- Manage Google Merchant Center feeds and Shopping for e-com clients

- Light conversion tracking work (we use ProfitMetrics, Reaktion, WhatConverts which are plug-and-play)

- Search terms mining at scale across languages using AI-driven systems you build

- Optimize Smart Bidding based on signal quality, diagnose underperformers holistically

- Help us improve our automation systems and internal tooling

- Log decisions as hypotheses in our AI cockpit so we can track what works

- Collaborate via Loom, Slack, and 
 with time-tracked reporting

- Schedule your own work and proactively flag when you need more hours allocated





Minimum requirements:



- Fluent in written and spoken English. We cannot have language barriers at this level

- 5+ years hands-on Google Ads, agency-side

- Has managed 3+ accounts for 12+ months with concrete before/after numbers in your portfolio. I expect you to have enough experience to be able to draw parallels to previous accounts, niches, setups etc. if you can't, you don't have enough experience

- Comfortable operating at $50,000+ monthly ad spend levels

- Can walk us through specific past accounts in depth: what was the strategy, who made it, why that decision, what was the result, and why did it happen. We want to see your thinking, not just your wins.

- Deep knowledge of Smart Bidding, Performance Max (including native brand exclusion), Google Shopping, Merchant Center feed optimization, Google Ads Scripts, GAQL

- Talks in POAS (profit on ad spend) and LTGP (lifetime gross profit), not only ROAS

- AI-augmented, not AI-dependent. Daily Claude/ChatGPT use, but answers Google Ads questions from your own knowledge

- Has personally built at least one workflow automation (Google Ads Script, Python, Sheets, Make/Zapier)

- Comfortable with the Google Ads API or willing to grow into it fast

- Stays current with industry developments (AI, the API, Google Ads platform changes)

- Self-scheduler. Owns deadlines. Proactively communicates when more time is needed.

- Long-term mindset, not stepping-stone seeker





Our main tools (all provided by us):



- Ads stack: Google Ads, Google Ads API, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Google Merchant Center, Channable

- Conversion tracking: ProfitMetrics, Reaktion, WhatConverts

- Project management: 

- Communication: Google Workspace (your own account), Slack, Loom

- AI: Claude Pro Max (multiple licenses), Gemini, ChatGPT

- Any other software you need to do the job well, within reason





Compensation:



- Base starts at $20/hour. Final rate depends on what you bring (agreed after we have seen your work).

- Revenue share: percentage of monthly revenue from each client account you own. When your client grows, your income grows.

- Retainer bonus: percentage of retainer fee for each client you successfully retain (structured with the right person)

- Performance bonuses paid quarterly for retention and growth wins

- Paid in advance monthly (you NEVER chase invoices). Later I can also pay 3 months in advance if the employee wants that.

- 2 weeks paid vacation per year + paid sick days, after 90-day trial passes.

- 13th month consideration built into total comp

- Paid learning time included



We track real, focused hours only (not screen-on time). 25-30 tracked hours per week equates to a 35-40 hour work week with breaks included.





Hiring process:



Step 1: Apply via this post with the items listed at the bottom.



Step 2: If shortlisted, record a short Loom video introducing yourself, your portfolio, and your perspective on Google Ads work.



Step 3: We exchange a few messages to dig deeper.



Step 4: You fill out a Google Form with specific case study questions.



Step 5: 30-45 minute video call with Kevin (our hiring manager).



Step 6: 30-45 minute video call with Rasmus (CEO).



Goal: right person onboarded within 1-2 months.





How We Work:



Weekly Meetings (later biweekly and eventually monthly)

- One 30-minute meeting per week to start. Once you are settled in, we move to biweekly and eventually monthly. Beyond that, most work is async via Loom and Slack.



Easy Communication

- Daily back-and-forth via Loom videos and screen recordings to save time and ensure clarity. We expect you can take a client call if needed, but we do very little live calling.



Detailed Reporting

- After each task, provide reporting/screenshots/videos along with exact time-tracking timestamps. All reporting is billable.





Cultural & Work-Mentality Expectations:



Open Communication & Solution Focus

- In Denmark, admitting when you are unsure or need help lets us troubleshoot together quickly. We need you to disagree with us when you have data.



Flat Hierarchy & Direct Feedback

- Low power distance: feel free to push back, give and receive feedback directly and constructively. Drop "Sir" and "Ma'am" early.



Supportive & Honest Environment

- We never shout, yell, or curse. Growth happens fastest when every opinion is heard and all feedback is delivered respectfully.



Quality Over Quantity & 80/20 Principle

- We prioritize doing it right the first time to minimize revisions. Focus on the 20% of effort that delivers 80% of the impact.



Initiative & Independence

- While support is always available, we value specialists who proactively identify opportunities, ask smart questions, suggest improvements, and tell us early when they need more time to deliver quality.



Time-Zone Flexibility

- Collaboration is primarily in Central European Time (UTC+1/UTC+2). You do not need to cover any specific hours. Rasmus, our CEO, is in Asia 9/10 months per year as well. Only 1 meeting per week is fixed (later biweekly/monthly).



Respectful Tone

- Directness coupled with respect: clear language, polite interactions, friendly meeting culture.





Future Growth Opportunities:



- Path to full-time within within 3-6 months months based on performance and mutual fit. Right now we can't get more clients because of capacity, when that has been freed up, we will onboard more, and I need someone that can allocate more time till we hit full-time.

- Revenue share grows as you take on more accounts

- Retainer bonus grows with client retention

- Direct client contact and account ownership grows over time

- Potential to lead a small team as we scale toward becoming the best lead-gen Google Ads agency in Denmark and beyond

- We train you in our task management system, How We Work, AI/Claude workflows, and automation systems. We do NOT train you in Google Ads.





How to apply:



Reply with the following in this order:



1. Start your reply with the word "POAS" as the first word (shows you read carefully)

2. One paragraph about the most recent Google Ads account you moved meaningfully. Include before/after numbers and what specifically YOU changed, the more nerdy and specific the better, but don't write a bible to me please.

3. Link to your portfolio or case studies

4. Link to your LinkedIn profile if you have one

5. One sentence on which AI tool you use daily and for what

6. One link to a workflow, script, or automation you have built

7. Your current weekly availability starting July or August 2026



Applications missing any of the above will not be reviewed.



Thank you for your interest.

title: Part-Time E-commerce Competitor Research VA (5 hrs/week, Long Term Role)
description:
Hello and thank you for taking the time to read this job post carefully.



Before I describe the role, I want to be transparent about something: 

this post is long on purpose. I have hired VAs in the past, and I have 

learned that the people who succeed in my team are the people who read 

carefully, follow instructions precisely, and value detail over speed. 

If you skim job posts and send generic applications, this role is not 

for you, and I encourage you to skip this one — it will save us both 

time.



ABOUT THE BUSINESS



I run a growing e-commerce business based in Europe. We sell women's 

fashion products online through Shopify, primarily targeting the 

Polish market, with plans to expand into other European countries. 

The business is profitable, organized, and scaling. I am building a 

small remote team of reliable people who can grow with the business 

over the next 12 to 24 months.



This role is part of that team-building. I am not hiring for a one-off 

task. I am looking for someone I can work with long-term, ideally a 

year or more, who becomes genuinely familiar with my business and my 

standards.



WHAT THIS ROLE INVOLVES



The core responsibility is competitor research. Every week, you will 

identify and document 10 to 15 competitor stores in the women's 

fashion e-commerce space, primarily in European markets (Poland, 

Italy, Spain, France, Germany, Netherlands). For each competitor, you 

will fill in a Google Sheet I provide with the following information:



- Store URL (direct link to the homepage)

- Meta Ad Library URL (direct link to their ads page on 

  
/ads/library)

- Date found (the day you added them to the sheet)

- Total number of products in their store

- Number of currently active ads in Meta Ad Library

- Activity level (dropdown selection: HIGH ACTIVITY for 40+ ads, 

  AVERAGE ACTIVITY for 20-39 ads, LOW ACTIVITY for 5-20 ads — 

  anything below 5 is not worth adding)

- Shopify theme they are using (Dawn, Sense, Refresh, Studio, 

  custom, or unknown)

- A short note if anything stands out (strong branding, unusual 

  product mix, interesting offer, etc.)



You will receive:



- A pre-built Google Sheet with all columns and dropdowns set up

- A clear list of qualification criteria for what counts as a 

  competitor

- Examples of past entries to use as a reference

- A short Loom video walkthrough showing exactly how to find 

  competitors, identify Shopify themes, and use Meta Ad Library

- A weekly 15-30 minute check-in to review your work and adjust 

  criteria as needed



The work involves:



- Searching for stores using Meta Ad Library (the primary tool), 

  Google search, Instagram, and TikTok

- Verifying each store is on Shopify (I will teach you how to 

  identify this in 30 seconds)

- Counting their products and active ads

- Identifying their Shopify theme

- Logging everything cleanly in the sheet



This is structured research work, not creative work. I am not asking 

you to analyze or strategize — I am asking you to bring me clean, 

accurate data every week without me having to chase you for it. The 

strategy is my job. Your job is to deliver the data.



EXPECTED HOURS AND SCHEDULE



- 10 to 15 hours per week

- Flexible schedule, you choose your hours

- Weekly deadline: every Friday by 6 PM Manila time

- One short check-in call per week, 15 to 30 minutes

- Consistency matters more than total hours



PAY AND PAYMENT TERMS



Compensation will be discussed during the interview stage and will be 

based on your experience, skill level, and the quality of your test 

task. I pay competitive rates for the Philippine market, with clear 

opportunities for raises based on performance — typically a raise 

after the first month, again after three months, and ongoing growth 

as your responsibilities expand.



What I can promise you regardless of starting rate:



- Weekly payments, sent every Friday via Wise or PayPal, without 

  exception

- Transparent raise structure with clear performance milestones

- 13th-month bonus after 12 months of continuous work

- Paid time off starting at 5 days per year after 6 months, 

  increasing yearly

- Long-term stability — I am not building a revolving door of VAs, 

  I am building a small permanent team



I have never missed or delayed a payment to a VA, and I will not 

start with you. In return, I expect honesty about your hours, your 

availability, and any issues that come up. I do not punish honesty — 

I punish silence and disappearing.



WHO I AM LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate has:



- Fluent written English, clear and professional

- Experience with e-commerce research, dropshipping, Shopify, or 

  Meta Ads is a strong plus, but not strictly required

- Strong attention to detail — non-negotiable

- A reliable internet connection (10+ Mbps download minimum)

- Comfort with Google Sheets, browser tabs, and quick research

- Long-term mindset, looking for a stable part-time role

- Honesty about your skills, availability, and limitations



I do not care about fancy resumes. Some of the best VAs I have 

worked with had zero formal experience when I hired them. I care 

about whether you can read instructions, follow them precisely, 

deliver on time, and communicate clearly when something is wrong.



WHAT I DO NOT WANT



I am not interested in:



- Generic copy-paste cover letters

- People who claim experience they do not have

- VAs who go silent for days when a task is hard

- People who treat this as a short-term gig

- Anyone who needs to be reminded multiple times to deliver work



If any of the above sounds like you, please do not apply. We are not 

a good fit, and that is okay.



HOW THE HIRING PROCESS WORKS



Step 1: You apply following the application instructions below.

Step 2: If your application stands out, I will message you within 

        48-72 hours with a paid test task ($10 USD): find 3 

        competitors that meet my criteria, fill in the sheet, 

        deliver within 48 hours. This test is paid regardless of 

        whether I hire you.

Step 3: If your test is strong, we have a 20-minute video call.

Step 4: If the call goes well, we start a 2-week trial at the full 

        hourly rate.

Step 5: After the trial, if both sides are happy, we continue 

        long-term.



APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS — READ THIS PART CAREFULLY



I receive a lot of applications, and the only way to filter through 

them efficiently is to ask every applicant to follow a specific 

format. Applications that do not follow this format will be ignored 

without exception. This is not because I am being difficult, it is 

because following instructions is the single most important skill 

for this role.



Please start your application message with the exact code 

"Purple fox 2025" in all capital letters on the very first line, 

with absolutely nothing before it. Not "Hi", not "Hello", not your 

name. Just "Purple fox 2025" as the very first characters of your 

message.



On the second line, answer this question with a single number only, 

no units, no explanation: if I want 15 competitors researched per 

week and each takes 20 minutes, how many hours total is that per 

week? Just the number on its own line.



On the third line and below, please share:



1. Your full name and where you are based (city and country)

2. Your relevant experience (be honest, beginners welcome)

3. Your weekly availability (hours, days, timezone)

4. Your preferred payment method (Wise or PayPal) and the associated

5. Your internet speed (run a quick test at speedtest.net and share 

   the download/upload number)

6. One short paragraph (3-5 sentences) on why you want long-term 

   part-time work and what would make you stay in a role like this



Keep the total application under 300 words. Clear and 

instruction-following beats long and impressive every time.



FINAL NOTES



I will respond to qualifying applicants within 72 hours. If you do 

not hear back within 5 days, I have moved forward with other 

candidates. Do not take it personally, and feel free to apply to 

future posts of mine.



Thank you for reading this all the way through. The fact that you 

got this far already puts you ahead of most applicants. I look 

forward to working with someone who values the same standards I do.



Talk soon,

The Hiring Manager

title: Creative Specialist
Creators Influencer Outreach
description:
# Creator Outreach Specialist



Help DigitalZen get mentioned by relevant micro and nano creators in the ADHD, student, productivity, focus, screen-time, and digital wellbeing spaces.



## Job type



Part-time to full time (flexible)

Remote

Long-term



## About us



DigitalZen is a productivity app that helps people block distracting websites and apps, stay focused, and take control of their screen time.



Our users include students, ADHD/neurodivergent users, remote workers, Linux users, and people trying to break bad digital habits.



We already work on SEO and content. Now we need help getting DigitalZen introduced to new audiences through relevant creators, reviewers, and small influencers.



## The role



We are looking for an organized, self-starting Creator Outreach Specialist.



Your job is to find relevant nano and micro creators, contact them, manage follow-ups, coordinate simple collaborations, and help get DigitalZen mentioned by creators whose audiences care about focus, studying, productivity, ADHD, screen time, app blockers, or digital wellbeing.



This role is for someone who enjoys creator research, outreach, follow-ups, negotiation, tracking, and turning a broad goal into a clear working pipeline.



You should be comfortable working independently, making smart recommendations, and sending simple updates without needing daily management.



## What you will do



You will find and contact creators such as:



* ADHD / neurodivergent productivity creators

* Study and student productivity creators

* Productivity YouTubers

* TikTok creators

* Instagram creators

* Newsletter creators

* Small bloggers or reviewers

* Digital wellbeing creators

* App/tool reviewers

* Linux or tech productivity creators, when relevant



You will help with:



* Finding relevant nano and micro creators

* Checking if their audience is a good fit

* Collecting creator contact details

* Writing personalized outreach messages

* Following up

* Discussing simple collaboration options

* Coordinating creator posts, reviews, mentions, or demos

* Tracking creators in a clean spreadsheet or project board

* Tracking status, replies, pricing, posts, links, and results

* Sending a simple weekly report with what was done, what worked, what is stuck, and what you recommend next



## Collaboration types



We are open to different types of creator collaborations, including:



* Free Premium access

* Free lifetime access

* Affiliate links

* Creator discount codes

* Paid posts or reviews

* Hybrid deals: small fixed fee + affiliate bonus

* Giveaways

* Honest reviews or tool demos



You do not need to d
 every deal alone, but you should be able to recommend which offer makes sense for each creator.



## Notice



This role requires good judgment.



We are not looking for mass DM spam, fake engagement, generic AI outreach, or copy-paste messages.



We want thoughtful creator outreach. The goal is to find creators whose audience genuinely fits DigitalZen, then approach them in a personal and respectful way.



If your usual approach is “send the same message to hundreds of influencers,” this role is not a good fit.



## You may be a good fit if you have experience with



* Influencer outreach

* Creator outreach

* UGC outreach

* Nano or micro influencer campaigns

* Creator research

* YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, or newsletter creator outreach

* Managing creator outreach pipelines

* Writing personalized outreach messages

* Following up with creators

* Negotiating simple creator deals

* Tracking creator status, replies, pricing, and deliverables

* Working remotely with little supervision



## Nice to have, but not required



* Experience with SaaS, apps, productivity tools, student products, or ADHD-related products

* Experience with affiliate programs

* Experience with creator discovery tools such as Modash, Heepsy, Social Blade, Grin, or similar

* Experience tracking creator performance using links, coupons, or UTM links

* Experience with Notion, Google Sheets, Airtable, Trello, ClickUp, Asana, or similar tools



## Personality fit



We are looking for someone who is:



* Organized

* Self-starting

* Careful

* Independent

* Good at research

* Good at follow-up

* Comfortable contacting people

* Comfortable working remotely

* Able to write clear and natural English

* Able to judge creator quality, not just follower count

* Able to bring recommendations, not only questions



The founder has limited management capacity, so this role needs someone who can bring structure and keep the creator outreach process moving without daily babysitting.



## Long-term fit



This is a long-term role, starting with an initial evaluation period so both sides can see if it is a good fit.



We care about quality, judgment, organization, and consistency more than volume.



If the fit is good, this can grow into an ongoing role helping DigitalZen build a repeatable creator outreach system.



## How to apply



Please reply with:



1. A short summary of your relevant creator or influencer outreach experience

2. Examples of creator/influencer campaigns you have worked on

3. Which platforms you have experience with: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, newsletters, blogs, etc.

4. The tools you use to manage creator outreach pipelines

5. Your hourly or monthly rate

6. Your availability

7. A short answer to this question:



If you were helping DigitalZen, how would you find nano or micro creators who could realistically bring relevant users?



Please do not send a generic application. Generic applications will be ignored.

title: SEO & AI Search Lead (GEO/AEO)
description:
Position overview 



We're hiring an SEO & AI Search Lead to own how Elevator Goods' brands (
) show up in AI search. When someone asks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, or Google’s AI Overviews for the best hotel pillow or the best daily wellness powder, our brands should be the answer, organically. Today we have excellent press and a strong affiliate program, but we are close to invisible inside AI answers for the high-intent questions that actually drive purchases. Our publicist owns earned media and our affiliate lead owns commerce. You own everything they do not: Reddit and community, comparison and buying-guide content, the technical structuring that makes our pages quotable by AI, and the measurement that proves it is working. This starts as a contract and converts to a permanent seat once you show the lift.



Responsibilities 



- OWN AI SHARE OF VOICE. Make Elevator’s brands appear, and rank, in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI Overviews for our highest-intent buyer questions

- COMMUNITY. Build an authentic, non-spammy presence on Reddit and Quora (r/sleep, r/Mattress, r/BuyItForLife and the equivalents for each brand). Seed honest threads, mobilize real customers, run founder AMAs

- COMPARISON & GUIDE CONTENT. Spec and ship comparison pages (FluffCo vs Quince, vs Brooklinen, and more) and buying guides, structured for AI extraction with schema markup, short answers, and clear factual claims

- AUTHORITY PLACEMENTS. Work with our publicist to land and upgrade placements in the category-defining roundups AI trusts most (Sleep Foundation, Sleepopolis, Wirecutter), pushing for named top picks, not honorable mentions

- ENTITY LAYER. Own Wikidata, consistent brand descriptions across the web, and founder thought leadership on LinkedIn

- MEASUREMENT. Stand up and run an AI-visibility tracker (Profound, Peec, or Otterly), set the baseline, and report monthly on share of voice and citation position against a fixed prompt set

- FEEDBACK LOOP. Tell PR, affiliate, and brand exactly which sources, claims, and formats are moving AI answers, and double down on what works



Requirements 



- A real track record moving organic visibility, whether classic SEO, content, or community, with proof you changed where a brand showed up

- Working knowledge of GEO/AEO: how LLMs select and cite sources, schema markup, and comparison-content structure

- Genuine Reddit and community fluency. You know how to add value without getting banned

- Strong editorial writing for comparison and buying-guide content. You can make a factual claim land and be quotable

- Comfort being measured on one hard metric: our presence and position in AI answers for a fixed set of buyer prompts

- Completely fluent in AI tools, using Claude and the modern AI toolkit daily

- Self-starter energy. This function does not exist yet. You are building it from zero

- Remote-ok, fluent async, comfortable working across time zones



Benefits 



- Own a brand-new, high-leverage function across a multi-brand portfolio from day one

- Contract-to-hire with a clear path to a permanent lead seat once you show the lift

- Direct partnership with our publicist, affiliate lead, and brand teams

- Work with the best AI tooling and the autonomy to use your own judgment

- Competitive compensation + benefits

title: CONSTRUCTION ESTIMATOR (CIVIL and BUILDING) — AUSTRALIAN CONSTRUCTION COMPANY
description:
Full-time or part-time remote, from the Philippines. Australian business hours. Above-market pay for the right person. Long-term. Flexible terms. Direct to the people who run the business.



Read the tender, take off the quantities, price it to win.



This is a sales-focused estimating seat inside an established Australian construction company that delivers building, civil, and infrastructure work across private, commercial, and government projects. You'll price the work the business tenders for, from bulk excavation, drainage, and subdivision through to low-rise residential, commercial, and council and community facility builds. The estimate is how they win the job, so they want someone who can read a tender, take off the quantities, price it accurately, and put together a response that gets them over the line.



WHY THIS ROLE

One established employer, broad scope. You'll estimate across the company's full range of work, civil and building, so the projects stay varied and your experience keeps broadening.



Direct to the decision-makers. No middle layer. Your numbers go straight to the people who run the business, and your judgement is trusted from the start.



Flexible terms. Part-time or full-time depending on what suits you. Tell us your availability and we'll work with it.

Above-market pay for the right person. This is not a budget hire. They pay well for estimators who are accurate and fast, and they pay on time.



Long-term and stable. A full-time, ongoing seat with a company that has a steady tender pipeline.



ABOUT THE ROLE

The estimator owns the desk-side tendering work, from first read of the tender documents through to the priced submission. The role is sales-focused: the goal is not only an accurate number but a tender response that wins the job. You'll work across both sides of the business, so the projects range from civil packages to building works, and the documents and rates change with them.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Interpret the tender. Read tender documents, drawings, specifications, and scope of works. Identify what's in, what's out, and what needs clarifying with the client or the principal.



Quantity takeoffs. Measure quantities from drawings using digital takeoff software. Work cleanly from incomplete or conflicting documents and flag the gaps.



Price the works. Build up the estimate across labour, plant, materials, and subcontractors. Source and compare supplier and subcontractor quotes, and maintain the rate libraries.



Develop the tender response. Put together the priced submission with clarifications, qualifications, and assumptions stated clearly. Frame the bid so it reads well to the client and gives the business its best shot at winning.



Submit and follow up. Hit tender deadlines, lodge through the relevant portals, and capture post-tender feedback to sharpen the next one.



The work spans civil (bulk and detailed excavation, drainage, subdivision, roadworks, utilities, infrastructure) and building (low-rise residential, commercial, council and community facilities). You'll see both. Tell us where you're strongest.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring for estimating judgement and tender discipline, not a rigid checklist. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



Demonstrated estimating experience in civil and/or building construction. Australian experience is strongly preferred. Strong candidates with New Zealand, UK, US, or offshore-for-Australian-client experience are welcome to apply.



Confident reading construction drawings and specifications and producing accurate takeoffs.



Estimating software fluency. The role uses tools like CostX, Buildsoft, Cubit, Bluebeam, Groundplan, PlanSwift, and (for civil) 12d and Trimble. No specific one is required. Tell us which you know best.



Comfortable sourcing and comparing subcontractor and supplier pricing, and building up rates from first principles.

Clear written and spoken English. Confident raising RFIs and clarifications and explaining your numbers.



Accurate, organised, and deadline-driven. You can run several live tenders at once without dropping the detail.

Reliable home internet and a quiet, professional home workspace.



Nice to have (not required): familiarity with Australian Standards and measurement methods (ANZSMM, NATSPEC), Australian tender portals (Tenderlink, VendorPanel, ProcurePoint, Estimate One), and a working sense of Australian supplier and subcontractor pricing.



Out of scope: site supervision and project management (handled by the delivery team), and business development and client sales (handled by the people who run the business).



WHO YOU ARE

You think like the person trying to win the job, not just price it. You take pride in a clean, defensible estimate and you know which clarifications and qualifications protect the bid. You can work fro
ssy documents without guessing, you ask the right questions early, and you hit the deadline. You'd rather hold a long-term seat with a stable employer than chase short freelance gigs.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply directly via OJP. Attach your resume (PDF). In your application message, answer the questions below. Short, direct, specific answers. No AI fluff. Applications that skip the questions won't be progressed.



1. YOUR BACKGROUND. How many years have you estimated, how much of it civil versus building, and which is your strongest discipline? Give the typical project types and value ranges you've priced.



2. A REAL TENDER, END TO END. Pick one tender you priced. Tell us the project, the sector, the rough value, the software you used, what you were responsible for, and whether it won.



3. TAKEOFFS. Walk us through how you take off quantities from drawings: which software, and what you do when the documents are incomplete or contradict each other.



4. PRICING. How do you source and compare subcontractor and supplier rates, and how do you build up a rate when you don't have a quote to work from?



5. AUSTRALIAN CONTEXT. What Australian estimating experience do you have, if any, including standards, measurement methods, tender portals, or supplier knowledge? If none, tell us the closest market you've estimated for.



6. SOFTWARE. List the estimating tools you've actually used, say which you know best, and note any you taught yourself.



7. LOGISTICS. Your availability (part-time or full-time, and which hours you can cover against Australian business hours), expected monthly pay in PHP, and your earliest start date.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Strong fits go to a short video interview and a brief estimating exercise.

title: Decision Analyst

title: Detail-Oriented Document Editor — Photoshop & Adobe Acrobat (Template Work)
description:
We're looking for a meticulous, reliable document editor to update and finalize documents from templates we provide. This is straightforward, repeatable work for someone who is fast, accurate, and careful with details. You'll be given the templates and clear instructions on exactly what goes where — your job is to plug in the correct information (mostly numbers and text fields) and return clean, professional, print-ready files.



Accuracy matters most. A single mistyped number is a problem, so we need someone who double-checks their work every time.



What You'll Do





Edit documents using provided Photoshop (PSD) and Adobe Acrobat (PDF) templates

Enter numbers and text into the correct fields exactly as instructed

Match existing fonts, sizing, alignment, and formatting so edits look seamless

Export and save final files in the correct format and naming convention

Proofread and double-check every entry before submitting

Keep files organized and turn work around within agreed deadlines





Requirements





Proficient in Adobe Photoshop (editing layers, matching fonts, exporting clean files)

Proficient in Adobe Acrobat (editing PDFs, working with form fields and text)

Strong attention to detail and accuracy with numbers

Able to follow written instructions precisely and consistently

Reliable internet connection and your own licensed Adobe software

Good written English for receiving instructions and reporting back

Dependable and responsive during agreed working hours





Nice to Have





Experience with template-based or high-volume document work

Basic InDesign or Illustrator skills

Experience organizing and naming files for easy handoff



How to Apply



To show you read this and pay attention to detail, please do the following:





Start your message with the word PRECISION.

Briefly describe your experience with Photoshop and Adobe Acrobat.

Share 1–2 samples or a short portfolio of document/template editing work (if available).

Tell us your available hours and your rate.





Applications that don't start with the keyword will not be reviewed. Strong candidates may be asked to complete a short paid test edit.



We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Operations & Systems Integrator
description:
Business Systems & Process Specialist (6-12 Month Project)



Full Time Remote Position



About Us



Select Glass is a growing glazing company based in Perth, Western Australia.



We specialise in:



* Glass replacement

* Shower screens

* Mirrors

* Sliding wardrobe doors

* Aluminium windows and doors

* Commercial glazing

* Security screens and doors



The business is growing rapidly and we are investing heavily in systems, people and infrastructure.



Our goal is to build a company that can operate, scale and eventually expand into multiple locations without relying on the owner being involved in every decision.



We are looking for a highly organised and process-driven person to help us build the operating system behind the business.



This is a 6-12 month transformation project with the opportunity to continue on a contractor basis afterwards.







The Mission



Your job is not to run the business.



Your job is to document, organise and systemise the business.



You will work directly with the owner to extract knowledge, build systems, document processes and create the training materials required for future staff and locations.



By the end of the project, the business should have a complete operational framework that allows it to scale efficiently.







What You Will Be Doing



Process Mapping



Document every major business process including:



* Lead handling

* Sales

* Quoting

* Scheduling

* Purchasing

* Workshop operations

* Installation procedures

* Quality control

* Finance processes

* Staff onboarding







SOP Development



Create:



* Standard Operating Procedures

* Process maps

* Flowcharts

* Decision trees

* Checklists

* Training guides



You will regularly receive Loom recordings from the owner and convert them into documented systems.







Training System Creation



Build:



* Staff onboarding programs

* Training manuals

* Role-specific training pathways

* Knowledge base documentation



Roles include:



* Virtual Assistants

* Administrators

* Trade Assistants

* Glaziers

* Branch Managers







 Systems Development



Build a framework that allows the business to continually document and improve itself.



This includes:



* Documentation standards

* SOP templates

* Process review procedures

* Training systems

* Continuous improvement systems



We want a process for creating processes.







KPI & Performance Reporting



Assist with creating:



* Lead dashboards

* Sales dashboards

* Quote conversion reporting

* Operational KPI tracking

* Staff performance reporting







Essential Skills



* Exceptional written English

* Process mapping experience

* SOP creation experience

* Strong organisational skills

* Excellent attention to detail

* Ability to think in systems

* Ability to work independently

* Strong problem-solving ability







Highly Desirable



* Operations management experience

* Business systems experience

* Project management experience

* Documentation experience

* Service business experience

* Experience creating training programs

* Experience building company playbooks

* AI tool experience (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.)







What Success Looks Like



At the end of the project:



* Every major business process is documented.

* A complete SOP library exists.

* New staff can be onboarded using training systems.

* KPI dashboards are operational.

* The business is significantly less dependent on the owner.

* A Select Glass Operations Manual exists.

* A Branch Replication Playbook exists for future locations.







Hours



38 Hours Per Week



Remote



Long-term contractor opportunity available after the initial project.







How To Apply



Please answer the following:



1. Tell us about the largest systems or documentation project you have worked on.

2. What tools have you used to create SOPs, process maps and training systems?

3. Describe your process for turning a Loom video into a documented system.

4. Explain how you would build a business that relies less on the owner over time.

5. Provide examples of SOPs, manuals, playbooks, dashboards or systems you have created.

6. What hourly rate are you seeking?



At the top of your application write:



"I BUILD SYSTEMS"



Applications without this phrase will not be considered.







 Paid Assessment



Shortlisted applicants will be provided with a Loom video of a real business process.



Applicants will be asked to:



* Create an SOP

* Create a checklist

* Create a training guide

* Suggest improvements to the process



This paid assessment will form part of the selection process.

title: Executive Assistant to CEO
description:
Position Overview:



As the Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring the smooth and efficient functioning of the executive office. Your primary responsibility will be to provide comprehensive administrative support to the CEO, managing their schedule, and coordinating various tasks to enhance productivity. Your ability to maintain confidentiality, exercise sound judgment, and proactively handle administrative duties will contribute to the overall effectiveness of the CEO's office.





Pay Range: $8 per hour with a performance review scheduled after 90 days of employment. We believe in rewarding exceptional talents.





About Power Plus Systems:



Power Plus Systems LLC has been a dominant force in the residential electrical contracting industry for two decades, and we continue to lead the way. Our vision is to successfully wire 28,000 homes to completion by the year 2029, ensuring safe and efficient electrical solutions, thereby making a positive impact on the lives of our customers and communities. At Power Plus Systems, LLC, a position with us isn't just a job; it's an opportunity to grow and develop within a company that genuinely appreciates your contributions and dedication to our shared mission.





Objectives:

• Manage and organize the CEO's daily schedule, including meetings, appointments, and travel arrangements.

• Act as a gatekeeper, screening and prioritizing communications to the CEO.

• Coordinate and facilitate communication between the CEO and internal/external stakeholders.

• Anticipate the CEO's needs and proactively handle tasks to ensure optimal time management.

• Coordinate special projects and initiatives as assigned by the CEO.





Competencies:

• Exceptional organizational and multitasking skills, with keen attention to detail.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to maintain confidentiality and exercise discretion in handling sensitive information.

• Proficient in using Microsoft Office and Google Suites.

• Familiarity with scheduling software; experience with additional productivity tools is an advantage.

• Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively with individuals at all levels.

• Proactive problem solver and resourceful thinker.





Equipment Requirements:

• Must own a reliable computer or laptop capable of handling administrative tasks efficiently.

• Must own and actively use an iPhone and/or MacBook or Mac computer for efficient communication and task management.

• High-speed internet connection to support video calls, cloud-based collaboration, and remote work.





Physical Requirements:

• Extended periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.



Benefits:

• Growth opportunities in a well-established company.

• Ongoing training and professional development opportunities.

• Opportunity for advancement within the company.

• A supportive and collaborative work environment.

• Company-observed paid United States holidays (full time).

• Paid vacation.





How to Apply:



If you are ready to join Power Plus Systems, LLC, a well-established residential electrical contractor that values its tea
mbers and offers excellent benefits, please submit your application through the link below.




/internationalcareers



Power Plus Systems, LLC is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from all backgrounds to apply.



Join us at Power Plus Systems, LLC, and be part of our continued success as we embark on the next 20 years of excellence in residential electrical contracting!

title: Technical Onboarding Manager (Customer Success & Tech Support) - $900 Base + Performance Bonuses
description:
JOB OVERVIEW



We are hiring a Technical Onboarding Manager (TOM).



Your job is to guide new clients through their first 48 hours inside the program. You remove confusion, fix tech issues, assign the right 1:1 Coach, and make sure clients are fully set up before strategy begins.



This is not a passive support role. You are responsible for structure, clarity, activation speed, and client confidence.



This is a client-facing role. You must be clear, confident, calm, and reliable.



Most of our clients are 45+ and not tech-savvy. Patience and strong communication are required.



BENEFITS



- $900/month guaranteed base

- Performance bonuses based on CSAT (client rating) and CSQ (coach rating)

- OTE: $1,050–$1,400/month

- Bonus tiers from $30–$100 per category (minimum 20 surveys / 20 handoffs per month)

- Fully remote, long-term role

- Clear scorecard and monthly reviews

- Career growth path (Senior TOM, Lead TOM, CSM)

- 4,000+ clients served since 2019



SCHEDULE



- 7.5 hours per day (Monday to Friday)

- No fixed shift required. You may work a straight or split shift.

- You must attend tea
etings (usually 3pm CET)

- Work 7.5 total hours per day within the 8 AM ET to 2 AM ET coverage window, not across the entire window

- Confirm your preferred working hours during hiring

- Maintain a schedule that is sustainable long term



Consistently low energy or repeated mistakes caused by poor schedule management will be treated as performance issues.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Run structured Activation Calls

- Fully activate every client within 48 hours. Activation means the client has access to Kajabi, Slack, the Client Master Sheet, AI tools (AVA & VERA), understands where everything is, has a Coach assigned, and has their Kickoff Call booked.

- Book Kickoff Call same day or next day

- Assign the correct 1:1 Coach based on phase, fluency, timezone, and availability

- Build authority for the assigned Coach so the client feels confident before strategy begins

- Ensure basic access or setup issues do not reach Coaches

- Update CRM immediately after each call

- Send clear handoff notes to Coaches

- Upload all call recordings

- Reply in #tech-support within 24 hours (weekdays)

- Onboard 20–25 clients per week. Activation Calls are structured and typically 30–45 minutes.

Some weeks are high-volume during promotions. Quality and clarity must remain strong under pressure.

- Keep your calendar accurate and available

- Proactively manage your calendar capacity and flag issues early

- Avoid repeated client-facing process errors



Main goal: Zero confusion for the client. No surprises for the Coach.



CORE STANDARDS



- 100% activation within 48 hours

- CSAT average 85%+

- No Kickoff Call no-shows

- Prevent basic technical escalations

- High CRM accuracy and immediate handoffs

- 24-hour Slack response time

- Reliable, consistent performance



REQUIREMENTS



- Strong customer support or onboarding experience

- C1 English or higher

- Calm with older or low-tech clients

- Comfortable repeating instructions clearly multiple times

- Follows SOPs and scripts closely

- Advanced Slack skills

title: Personal Assistant, Sales, Business Development
description:
--



## Job Title

**Executive & Sales Virtual Assistant — Online Selling, B2B Outreach & PA Support (Australian company, long-term)**



## Type of work

Part Time, can become Full time



## Salary

[PHP 35,000–55,000 / month for a strong full-timer 



---



## Job Description



Hi! I run **Absolute Engineering Solutions**, a precision CNC machining business in Australia. I'm growing fast and need a sharp, reliable right hand to take work off my plate so I can stay focused on running the shop. This is a **long-term role** for someone who's proactive, organised, and great with people — not someone who waits to be told every step.



You'll wear three hats:



### 1. Sell my vehicles online (and other gear)

- Create and manage listings across
 Marketplace, Gumtree, Car sales and similar

- Write sharp descriptions, tidy up photos (Canva), price competitively from your research

- Field enquiries, qualify buyers, coordinate inspections and follow up to close the sale



### 2. Chase engineering & manufacturing companies (the big one)

- Build target lists of engineering, fabrication and manufacturing companies in Australia

- Reach out by
 and phone to introduce our machining services and win new project enquiries

- Follow up relentlessly (politely), book quotes/meetings into my calendar, and keep the pipeline moving

- Also help market and sell surplus **machine tools** to the right buyers



### 3. Personal assistant / admin

- Plan and book my holidays and travel — research, itineraries, flights, accommodation

- General admin: inbox and calendar help, research, data entry into our Google Sheets / CRM



## You'll be a great fit if you have

- **Excellent written and spoken English** — you'll be representing my business to customers

- Real **sales, lead-generation or appointment-setting** experience (cold outreach doesn't scare you)

- Experience listing/selling on online marketplaces

- Strong organisation, initiative and follow-through — you chase things to "done"

- Comfortable with Google Sheets, Gmail a reliable computer and internet

-Experience in Manufacturing or CNC Machining and Machine Sales

- **Bonus:** experience working with Australian businesses, or any exposure to engineering/manufacturing/B2B sales

MUST HAVE GREAT SKILLS WITH AI TO GET THE MOST OUT OF THIS ROLE (I CAN PAY SUBSCRIPTION)



## Hours

[e.g. Monday–Friday, with a few hours overlapping Australian business hours — set your time zone expectation here. Philippines time is the same as Perth/AWST.]



---

1. Start your message with the word **TITANIUM** so I know you read the whole ad.

2. In a few sentences, tell me about your most relevant experience — especially any **sales or outreach** results you're proud of (numbers welcome).

title: Experienced Customer Support Manager for US Fashion Dropshipping Store
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Customer Support Manager for a fast-growing US fashion dropshipping store.

This is not an entry-level Customer Support Representative role.

You will initially handle the complete customer support workload yourself. You do not need to manage a team immediately, but you must already have the experience, ownership and decision-making ability of a manager.

As the store grows and the workload becomes too large for one person, we will hire additional Customer Support Representatives. You may then help train, monitor and manage them.



ABOUT THE STORE



We operate a fashion dropshipping store focused on customers in the United States.

The store is scaling quickly, so protecting customer satisfaction, profitability, payment accounts and backend stability is extremely important.

You will work with fixed Google Drive documents, Google Sheets, SOPs and customer support workflows.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Handle all daily customer
s independently

• Keep the inbox organized and make sure no customer is ignored

• Maintain a response time of approximately 3–6 hours during working hours

• Handle questions about orders, tracking, delivery, sizing and products

• Manage cancellations, replacements, refunds and returns

• Handle complaints about product quality, sizing and delivery delays

• Apply our return and refund strategies correctly

• Prevent unnecessary full refunds wherever a suitable solution is possible

• Protect company profitability while maintaining professional customer service

• Prevent disputes and chargebacks by responding quickly and solving problems proactively

• Handle Shopify disputes and chargebacks

• Handle PayPal claims when required

• Collect and submit the correct evidence for disputes

• Track open, won and lost disputes

• Review lost disputes and improve future cases

• Update all required Google Drive documents and Google Sheets every day

• Follow all SOPs and company policies accurately

• Achieve customer support and dispute-related KPIs

• Report recurring product, sizing, quality or delivery problems

• Communicate clearly with the Supply Chain Manager about delayed or problematic orders

• Suggest improvements to templates, workflows and customer support processes

• Eventually help train and manage additional Customer Support Representatives



YOUR MAIN OBJECTIVE



Your job is not only to answer
s.

Your main objective is to:

• Keep customers informed and satisfied

• Reduce avoidable refunds and returns

• Prevent disputes and chargebacks

• Improve dispute win rates

• Protect company profitability

• Keep the complete customer support operation accurate, organized and measurable



REQUIREMENTS



• Direct experience with e-commerce dropshipping customer support

• Previous experience as a Customer Support Manager, Senior Customer Support Representative or similar senior role

• At least 3 months of experience working for one dropshipping store that consistently generated at least $100,000 per month

• Proven experience handling a substantial daily customer support workload

• Experience with fashion or apparel dropshipping is strongly preferred

• Experience handling quality and sizing complaints

• Experience with refunds, returns, replacements and cancellations

• Experience with Shopify disputes and chargebacks

• Experience with PayPal claims is a strong advantage

• Strong written English

• Experience with Shopify

• Strong experience with Google Drive and Google Sheets

• Comfortable working with fixed SOPs, templates, sheets and KPIs

• Able to work independently without constant supervision

• Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills

• Available for a full-time, long-term position

• Reliable, accurate, proactive and highly organized



TOOLS AND SYSTEMS



Experience with the following is preferred:

• Shopify

• Gorgias or a similar customer support platform

• Google Drive

• Google Sheets

• Shopify Payments disputes

• PayPal claims

• KPI and dispute tracking sheets



WORKING CONDITIONS



• Full-time position

• Long-term opportunity

• Remote work

• US fashion dropshipping store

• Hands-on role

• Fixed SOPs and Google Sheets workflows

• Daily accountability and measurable performance

• Opportunity to grow into managing a larger CS team



COMPENSATION



$5–$6 per hour, depending on experience and proven results.



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following via WhatsApp to:


Your CV

A link to a short application video of no more than 5-7 minutes



Answer the following questions in your video:

1. Briefly introduce yourself and explain your previous experience in e-commerce dropshipping customer support, especially as a CS Manager or Senior CS Representative.

2. Which dropshipping store did you work for that consistently generated at least $100,000 per month, how long did you work there, and what were your main responsibilities?

3. Why did you leave your most recent role, and why do you want to work as a Customer Support Manager?

4. Most tickets in fashion dropshipping involve sizing or product-quality complaints. Explain how you handle these cases while keeping the customer satisfied and protecting company profitability.

5. What is the best contribution, improvement or result you achieved in your previous customer support role?

7. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, explain your current schedule and whether you are genuinely available for a full-time role.

IMPORTANT



Do not apply if you have no direct dropshipping customer support experience.

Do not apply if you have never worked for a store consistently generating at least $100,000 per month.

Applications without a CV and video will not be considered.

CS A-PLAYER

title: Developer & Technical Support Specialist : Part-Time, Ongoing, Fully Remote
description:
We are a U.S.-based executive coaching and leadership development company serving senior leaders and organizations nationwide. As we grow our online presence, digital learning programs, and AI-enabled tools, we are looking for a versatile, dependable developer and technical support specialist to be our go-to person for technology across the business.

This is a long-term, full-time remote role for someone who is reliable, communicative, and genuinely committed. You will own our websites and also serve as the first point of contact for the day-to-day technology that keeps our team and clients running, from our online learning academy to video conferencing, Microsoft 365, integrations, and everyday software support. We are looking for someone who can both build and support, and who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems.

About the Role

Your work will span three connected areas: building and maintaining our websites, launching and managing our online learning academy, and providing broad technical support across the tools our team and clients rely on. This is not a narrow coding-only role. It is a broad technical operations role for someone who enjoys both building systems and supporting the people who use them.

The exact mix will shift over time as our needs evolve, so we value someone adaptable who can grow the role with us. You will work closely with our project coordinator and directly with leadership, flag issues early, document your work, and follow agreed processes rather than making changes independently to live environments.

Key Responsibilities

• Website development & maintenance — Build, update, and maintain our WordPress websites (front-end and back-end), keeping them fast, secure, mobile-responsive, and easy to manage. Stand up new sites as needed and cross-link them within our web ecosystem.

• Online learning academy — Help launch, manage, and maintain our online learning platform: setting up courses and users, integrating content and assessments, troubleshooting issues, and keeping the learner experience smooth.

• Staging, migrations & hosting — Build and test changes in staging, then execute live migrations only during approved windows and under supervision. Keep hosting, domains, DNS, SSL, redirects, and related configurations stable, documented, and secure.

• Change control & rollback planning — Test thoroughly before going live, back up before major changes, prepare rollback plans for website, DNS, LMS, or integration updates, and never make unauthorized changes to live or DNS settings.

• Cybersecurity & access management — Support basic cybersecurity hygiene, including plugin/theme updates, malware scans, user access reviews, MFA, role-based permissions, password manager use, and documented onboarding/offboarding procedures.

• Data privacy & confidentiality — Maintain confidentiality and follow secure handling practices when accessing client, learner, assessment,
, video, AI tool, and internal business systems.

• Communications & collaboration tech — Support tools that power our meetings and client work, such as Zoom, Teams, and other video-conferencing platforms, including setup, troubleshooting, recordings, permissions, and integrations.

• Office & productivity support — Provide hands-on help with Microsoft 365 / Office (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams), file sharing, permissions, account setup, and general software issues for the team.

•
, forms & deliverability — Support
/domain configuration and deliverability basics, including SPF, DKIM, DMARC, form notifications,
 routing, and troubleshooting issues that affect client or prospect communications.

• Tools, automation & integrations — Connect and maintain third-party tools, forms, scheduling, CRM, assessment,
 marketing, payment, automation, and AI-enabled tools so our systems work together smoothly.

• AI-enabled workflows — Support setup, testing, troubleshooting, integrations, prompt/tool documentation, and escalation when custom AI development or outside expertise is needed.

• Analytics & tracking — Maintain basic website analytics and tracking setup, such as Google Analytics, Search Console, landing-page tracking, and form conversion checks.

• General technical support — Act as our first responder for the wide range of tech issues that come up across the business, researching solutions, coordinating with vendors or outside developers when needed, and following through to resolution.

• Quality, documentation & reliability — Create and maintain simple SOPs, document setups and procedures, keep recurring tasks repeatable, and communicate clearly about status, risks, and next steps.

• Collaboration & tracking — Work within our project management system (
), give clear status updates, and coordinate with the team on priorities and timelines.

Required Skills & Experience

• Proven experience building and maintaining WordPress websites (front-end and back-end).

• Strong working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP.

• Hands-on experience with hosting, domain management, DNS configuration, SSL, redirects, and safe site migrations.

• Comfortable with staging environments, backups, QA testing, change control, and rollback planning.

• Experience administering or supporting an online learning platform / LMS, or strong ability to learn one quickly.

• Solid working knowledge of Microsoft 365 / Office and common collaboration and video-conferencing tools (Zoom, Teams).

• Familiarity with basic cybersecurity practices, password management, MFA, user permissions, and secure account access.

• Ability to handle sensitive client, learner, assessment, and business information with discretion and confidentiality.

• A broad, resourceful technical troubleshooting ability across software, accounts, integrations, and vendor support.

• Understanding of website security, performance optimization, responsive design, analytics, and basic
 deliverability.

• Excellent written English and clear, proactive communication.

• Reliable internet connection and a quiet, professional remote work setup.

Nice to Have

• Experience with learning platforms such as LearnDash, Teachable, Thinkific, Kajabi, or similar.

• Familiarity with AI tools, AI workflows, and AI-related integrations.

• Experience with Wix or other website builders.

• Experience with automation tools (Zapier, Make), APIs, CRM tools, payment tools, and
 marketing platforms.

• Experience with Google Analytics, Search Console, conversion tracking, and landing-page performance checks.

• Basic graphic or design sensibility for landing pages and learning content.

Who We're Looking For

Most of all, we want someone committed, dependable, trustworthy, and resourceful. The right person communicates consistently, takes ownership, meets deadlines, protects confidential information, and treats our systems as if they were their own. Because our technology needs are broad and growing, we want someone who is comfortable wearing several hats, learning new tools quickly, documenting what they do, and being our reliable problem-solver. We are building a long-term working relationship, not filling a short-term gig.

Work Details

• Schedule — Part-time. Some availability during U.S. business hours and a regular window of 11:00 AM–6:00 PM Philippines time for coordinated work and live support is preferred.

• Arrangement — 100% remote.

• Tools — WordPress, Wix, GoDaddy, an online learning platform, 
, Zoom, Microsoft 365, analytics tools, automation tools, AI-enabled tools, and standard collaboration platforms.

How to Apply

To help us find the right fit, please include the following in your application:

• A brief example of a technical problem you solved where you had to research, coordinate with a vendor, or protect a live environment.

• Your availability and preferred working hours.

Application tip: Please begin your reply with the word “HEART” so we know you read this posting carefully.

title: [CEBU BASED] Amazon Account Manager (Customer Service & Admin)
description:
QUICK HIGHLIGHTS



- Role: Join a profitable, fast-growing e-commerce brand as the detail-obsessed operator behind our customer service, admin, and Amazon operations. Our AI systems do the heavy lifting; you keep them honest and handle what they can't.

- Stage: Profitable, 12-year-old e-commerce business selling across 4 Amazon marketplaces (US, UK, DE, IRL), with consistent 30% YoY growth.

- Team: A lean team of A-Players in our Cebu office. Your work directly impacts company performance.

- Location & Schedule: Full-time and 100% on-site at our Cebu office, 11:00am to 8:00pm, Monday to Friday. This is not a remote or hybrid role, and there are no exceptions. Please only apply if you're based in Cebu and happy working from an office every day.

- Compensation: $800 to $1,120/month depending on experience, plus benefits (13 paid leave days, all PH holidays, HMO, performance-based 13th month, paid weekly).

- Why now: We've automated a huge amount of our operations. What's left needs a sharp, reliable human: the judgment calls, the customer conversations, the daily checks that keep everything running clean.



A QUICK NOTE ON THE TITLE



We've called this an Amazon Account Manager role because that's the background we want you to have. In practice it's broader than a pure Amazon job. Day to day, this is a customer service and admin role first, with Amazon operations as a core part of it. We specifically want someone who has worked inside Amazon Seller Central, because that experience and instinct is genuinely valuable to us, even though you won't be living in Amazon all day. If you have that background and you also love clean admin and great customer service, this is for you.



ABOUT THE ROLE



The heart of this job is customer service and admin, done to a very high standard. You'll handle customer and partner conversations our automated systems can't (with good judgment and excellent written English), keep our inboxes and records clean, run daily checks on our automated systems and flag anything off, and support our Amazon operations: Seller Central housekeeping, case follow-through, account-health monitoring. You'll also be cross-trained to run customer service solo when our ops lead is on leave: real responsibility, real trust.



This is a junior role with real room to grow into Amazon and e-commerce operations. What matters is not years of experience; it's accuracy, follow-through, and catching the thing nobody else noticed.



YOU'D BE A FIT IF YOU...



- Have 1+ year experience with Amazon Seller Central (VA, account admin, or CS role). You know your way around; you don't need to be a specialist.

- Have real customer service experience: you write clear, warm, professional replies and know when a situation needs escalating.

- Are detail obsessed: you catch errors before anyone else sees them.

- Follow SOPs exactly, and notice when the SOP itself is broken.

- Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, etc.) to work our systems.

- Write excellent English.



NOT A FIT IF...



- You're looking for remote, hybrid, or work-from-home arrangements. This role is on-site in Cebu, every day, no exceptions.

- You're primarily focused on PPC, creative, content, or brand strategy.

- You want to build automations and AI systems (we have that covered; this role operates them).

- You're looking for a senior catalog or account management position (this is a junior role).

- You need constant supervision, or dislike process, repetition, and detailed data tasks.

- You're agency-based or juggling multiple clients.



RESPONSIBILITIES



- Customer Service: handle the conversations our systems can't, in our brand voice, with judgment; cross-trained for solo CS cover when our ops lead is on leave.

- Admin Excellence: inboxes, reports, dashboards, data hygiene the team can trust, zero unforced errors.

- Systems Monitoring: daily checks on our automated systems; anything off gets flagged within one working day.

- Amazon Support: Seller Central housekeeping, case resolution with persistence and follow-through, account-health monitoring.

- Accurate time records and clean categorization, every day (we run on trust plus good data).



Attention to detail is critical for this role. We're looking for someone who actually reads job descriptions carefully, so when the form asks what your favorite number is, the answer is 99.



WHY JOIN US



- Clarity, not guesswork: You'll always know what's expected and where you stand. Clear SOPs, clear targets, fast and direct feedback.

- Your work gets seen: We measure work closely. If you take pride in accuracy and follow-through, good work gets noticed and rewarded, not lost.

- Stability: A profitable, 12-year-old business that pays weekly, on time, every time.

- Learning: Work directly with experienced e-commerce operators and modern AI tools every day.

- Culture: Low-drama. High-clarity. Feedback-friendly. Do good work, get treated like an adult.



HOW TO APPLY



To apply, please complete this short application form: 



Apply through the form only. Applications sent any other way will not be reviewed.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. We review your application form.

2. Initial conversation.

3. Deep dive into your Amazon and customer service experience.

4. Practical work-sample exercise (realistic scenarios from the actual role).

5. Final round interview on site in our Cebu office with leadership and culture fit.

Executive Assistant to the CEO (Full-Time, Remote)



???? Remote (Philippines)  |  ???? 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, Mon–Fri (8 paid hrs + 1 hr unpaid break)  |  ???? $1,200–$1,800/month  |  ???? Long-Term



Must-Haves (read this before you apply)





3+ years as an EA to a CEO or senior executive

Proven track record owning projects independently, start to finish, with no hand-holding

Available 8:00 AM–5:00 PM PST, Mon–Fri. Not flexible.

C2 (Mastery) English, written and verbal

If any of these don't fit, please don't apply, save us both the time.





Who We Are

A fast-casual restaurant brand built on quality, simplicity, and culture. We don't cut corners and we don't settle for "good enough."





Faith-guided. We don't require you to share our faith, but we do require respect for the values that flow from it.

High standard. Think the best fast-casual experience you've ever had: spotless, exceptional, every person genuinely glad to help. That's our bar.

People-first. We treat our team like family, with high standards starting at the top.





About the Role

You'll keep the CEO organized and focused: schedules,
s, confidential matters. But the core of this role is bigger than that:





Own projects end to end, from a vague request to a finished deliverable

Build and maintain trackers, run research to completion, manage recurring processes

Follow through without being chased

Operate with minimal supervision in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment





What We Value





Service first: genuine care for everyone you interact with on our behalf, vendors, team, clients

Honesty over comfort: say it when something's wrong, praise in public, handle issues in private

Ownership: when something falls through the cracks, you fix it and learn, no finger-pointing. When you're handed a project with no instructions, you build the plan yourself.

Relentless quality: you find the best option within the constraints and deliver it with confidence

Stewardship: you treat the CEO's time, information, and relationships like your own





Other Requirements





Proficient with AI tools, Google Workspace, MS Office, Notion, Zoom

Handles confidential information with complete discretion

Bonus: experience in restaurants, real estate, or multi-unit operations





How to Apply

Subject line: "Executive Assistant: [Your Name]"



Send all of the following in one
:





Resume + short cover letter on why you're the right fit

1-minute Loom or video introduction

Work sample: one thing you built independently for a past executive (tracker, doc, process, research deliverable). Redact anything confidential. This is the most important part of your application.

Written answers to:



Tell me about a project you owned independently for an executive, from a vague request to a finished deliverable. What was it, what did you build, and how did you keep it moving without being chased?

You receive 200
s for the CEO. 30 are urgent. Walk me through your exact process.

The CEO has a meeting in 20 minutes and an urgent client call just came in. What do you do?

The CEO needs 5 LA restaurants with private dining for 12, in 45 minutes. How do you deliver?

Write a short follow-up
 to a vendor who missed a deadline.







DISC profile, if you've taken one (any provider). If not, we'll do it together during the interview.

OnlineJobs.ph IQ score, if completed (informational only, not a filter)





Incomplete applications won't be reviewed.
