title: Virtual Admin Assistant (with Digital Marketing Skills)
description:
We’re hiring a Virtual Admin Assistant (with Digital Marketing Skills)



Remote | Part-Time to Full-Time | US Hours (PST)

$2.50+ per hour



We're looking for an organized, tech-comfortable Virtual Admin Assistant who also has a creative side. Alongside general admin and light tech tasks, you'll help grow our brand presence — creating LinkedIn posts, simple graphics, and short videos. If you're detail-oriented, quick to learn, and enjoy mixing structured admin work with content creation, this role is for you.

You don't need to be an IT professional or a professional designer — just comfortable with tools, eager to learn, and able to produce clean, on-brand content with guidance.



Work Schedule:

• Must be available during US business hours (8:00 a.m. – 5:00 p.m. PST)

• Starts as a part-time probationary role with potential to become full-time after 2 months based on performance



Responsibilities:



Content & Digital Marketing:

• Draft, schedule, and publish LinkedIn posts for the company page

• Design simple graphics for social media and internal use (e.g., Canva)

• Help maintain a consistent brand look, voice, and posting schedule

• Keep a simple content calendar and track basic engagement



Administrative & Executive Support

• Manage calendars, appointments, and meeting logistics

• Prepare and organize documents, reports, and presentations

• Perform data entry, file organization, and recordkeeping

• Take meeting notes and support tea
etings as needed

• Conduct research, organize data, and support special projects

• Handle sensitive information with confidentiality



Light Tech/Admin Support 

• Google Workspace basics: create/disable user accounts, reset passwords/MFA, assign groups/permissions, manage shared drives

• Provision and deprovision common tools (e.g., Slack, Zoom) using SOPs

• Keep simple asset & access logs up to date (spreadsheets)

• Troubleshoot very basic issues (login/access, profile settings) and escalate when needed

• Help maintain clean documentation and step-by-step guides for recurring tasks



Customer Support (Basic):

• Reply to basic customer inquiries or forward to the right tea
mber

• Track requests and follow-ups

• Keep client information updated and organized



General Tasks:

• Learn tools and processes quickly (Google Workspace, project trackers)

• Assist tea
mbers with ad hoc admin tasks

• Maintain records and Google Sheet reports



Qualifications and Skills:

• 2 years minimum of relevant admin or virtual assistant experience

• Good spoken and written English

• Willingness to learn and follow instructions

• Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage time effectively.

• Knowledge of common enterprise software and cloud applications (e.g., Office 365, Google Workspace).

• Strong internet connection and a quiet working environment

• Excel skill is a must!



What We Offer:

• Work-from-home flexibility with a supportive team environment

• Opportunity to grow with a dynamic and innovative company.

• Performance-based incentives

• Training and development to enhance your skills.



How to Apply:

Please send your application to 
 and include in the subject the word 'BAMBOO' then fill out this short form:



To be considered, you must include:

1. A 2-minute video recording introducing yourself and why you're a good fit

2. Your total years of experience

3. Your expected hourly rate



We look forward to hearing from you!

description:

Thanks!

title: Pre-Press Specialist
description:
Overview

We’re looking for a detail-oriented Pre-Press Specialist to support our production team by preparing high-quality, print-ready files for multiple printers. This role is critical in ensuring accuracy, speed, and consistency across all artwork before it goes into production.



Key Responsibilities

Prepare and convert design files (from Adobe Illustrator and Photoshop) into print-ready formats based on specific printer requirements

Separate artwork into proper layers (base white, design, and clear top layers) according to production specs

Create realistic mock-ups to showcase how designs will appear on cups for customer approval

Process files from multiple sources, including:

Custom designer submissions

Website orders (customer-created designs)

Wholesale artwork requests via

Ensure all files meet quality and technical standards before production

Communicate with the team in real time to resolve file issues and maintain workflow efficiency



Performance Expectations

Handle 150–180 files per week per specialist

Maintain an average turnaround time of ~10 minutes per file (depending on complexity)

Support continuous production needs, helping cover gaps in operational hours



Requirements

Strong proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Adobe Illustrator

Solid understanding of print production and different printer specifications/formats

High attention to detail with strong quality control skills

Ability to work efficiently under time pressure and manage high-volume tasks

Flexible availability, including potential weekend work and coverage across time zones

Responsive and reliable communication via Slack, Line, or WeChat during working hours

Follow up professionally

Book calls or create warm conversations for us

Strong experience with LinkedIn B2B cold outreach

Proven track record getting replies and booking calls

Good written English

Ability to personalize messages, not just spam templates

Experience with
 outreach is a plus

Self-motivated and able to work without daily supervision

What LinkedIn outreach campaigns have you done before?

title: Remote Home Care/Healthcare Recruiter
description:
IMPORTANT: We don't review applications on this platform. We use OLJ for job posting ONLY. If you want to be invited for an interview, directly APPLY on our page: 





About Us



At Helper Heroes, we’re on a mission to provide exceptional care and support to home care agencies in America. We believe in creating a true partnership where our employees act and feel like a true member of the American team they are matched with. Our goal is to help them create a compassionate, innovative, and efficient care experience for their clients and their families. To achieve this, we’re looking for a Helper Hero to join our team and help us shine even brighter!



About You



What sets us apart is YOU. You’re not just any virtual tea
mber—you’re a Helper Hero! If you’re passionate about making a difference, have a knack for organization, and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, you’re who we are looking for. If you’re the kind of person who loves tackling behind-the-scenes tasks with a smile, ensuring that our clients' caregivers and clients receive the best possible support, apply today!



Job Overview



We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented Recruiter to support recruitment, caregiver

onboarding, and administrative tasks for a growing home care business. This role is

ideal for someone with experience in healthcare recruitment and a passion for

streamlining operations. You will work closely with the owner to alleviate their workload,

enabling them to focus on business growth and client care.



Key Responsibilities



1. Recruitment & Onboarding:



- Manage end-to-end caregiver recruitment: screen applicants, schedule interviews, and coordinate orientation/training.

- Process onboarding documentation via ADP Workforce (e.g., electronic I-9s, employee handbook distribution).

- Track and ensure completion of state-mandated caregiver training (e.g.,via Active Insights).



2. Administrative Support



- Answer inbound calls during peak hours and manage voi
s/lead inquiries.

- Assist with client intake calls and referral source coordination.

- Provide general administrative support (e.g., scheduling, data entry).



3. Systems & Collaboration



- Utilize platforms like WellSky or Axiscare (training provided) to streamline workflows.

- Collaborate with the owner to refine processes and maintain organization.



Qualifications:



- Excellent written/verbal communication (fluent English).

- Strong organizational and time-management abilities.

- Proficiency with CRM systems,
 management, and cloud-based tools (e.g., Google Drive).

- Proactive mindset—anticipate needs before they arise.

- Proven experience in recruitment, specifically in healthcare or home care staffing.

- Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build rapport with candidates and tea
mbers.

- Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently and manage time effectively in a fast-paced environment.

- Familiarity with recruitment platforms and CRM tools

- A positive attitude, sense of humor, and a passion for helping others.



Attributes of a Successful Helper Hero:



- Empathy: You genuinely care about people and want to make a difference in their lives.

- Organization: You’re a master of multitasking and can keep everything running smoothly.

- Communication: You speak impeccable English. You’re a clear and friendly communicator, both written and verbal.

- Problem Solver: You can see the big picture when resolving complex issues and follow through until you reach full resolution.

- Self Starter: You work effectively without supervision and follow processes precisely.

- Reliability: You’re dependable, punctual, and always ready to step up when needed.



Why You’ll Love Working with Us:



- Competitive Base Pay: $6.50/hr for the first 6 months. (Among the highest in the homecare industry)

- Make a Difference: You’ll play a key role in ensuring that clients receive the best

care possible.

- Growth Opportunities: As we grow, so will you! There’s plenty of room for

advancement and learning.

- Fun & Supportive Team: We’re a tight-knit group that values collaboration,

compassion, and a good laugh.



Ready to Be a Hero?



If you’re excited about the opportunity to join our team, where you’ll be appreciated,

have a sense of purpose and inclusion and are willing to help us create a brighter, more

compassionate care experience, we can’t wait to hear from you! Apply today and let’s

make a difference together.



IMPORTANT: Directly apply and send your resume on our website: 
/helperheroes/

Full-Time | Remote | Long-Term Opportunity | Monthly Performance Bonuses

title: Senior Photo Editor (Architectural & Content)
description:
HIGH END, SENIOR PHOTO EDITORS ONLY - ARCHITECTURAL & CONTENT SPECIFIC

This is a unique photo editing opportunity and only the highest quality of photo editors, with the relevant experience and impressive portfolio need to apply. Excellent salary for the right candidate.





Clique Creative is South Australia's go-to for top-tier photography, videography, and marketing services. Our vision is to craft and inspire high-quality, consistent marketing solutions for property, people, and projects, while delivering a premium customer experience and fostering a fun, supportive workplace.



Clique Creative is on the hunt for a highly skilled Senior Photo Editor to join our growing creative team. If you've got a sharp eye for detail, expert-level Photoshop and Lightroom skills, and a passion for turning architectural, interior, and content photography into polished, high-impact imagery - we'd love to meet you.



In this role, you'll work across a broad and exciting range of photography, from structural and architectural shoots to interior design, new builds, headshots, and brand content. You'll collaborate closely with our Creative Director, Photography Coordinator, and photographers to deliver work that elevates our clients - property developers, architects, interior designers, and brands alike - and helps tell their story through standout visuals.



What You'll Do:

- Edit and retouch architectural, interior, new build, and content photography — including daylight and twilight/dusk imagery — to a high, vibrant, and visually appealing standard

- Remove imperfections, add lighting effects, and enhance image clarity across architectural, interior, and people-focused photography

- Remove unwanted objects or distractions for clean, polished final images

- Combine multiple exposures using flambient techniques for premium interior and architectural results

- Apply advanced editing techniques that enhance a property or space's appeal without compromising realism

- Use AI-assisted editing tools to boost efficiency and quality while keeping results natural and realistic

- Retouch people and headshot photography to a professional, polished finish

- Add virtual furniture and décor, or digitally declutter spaces, to help bring a finished space to life (a bonus skill, not essential)

- Keep your finger on the pulse of the latest editing software, techniques, and industry trends



Training & Mentoring New Editors

- Introduce new editors to our tools, editing style, and quality standards

- Run hands-on training sessions and share real examples of work that hits the mark

- Support new editors through their onboarding, providing feedback and guidance to help them thrive

- Help create and maintain training materials, guides, and checklists

- Partner with the Photography Coordinator to track progress and tailor ongoing development



About You

- 3+ years' experience in photo editing within architectural, interior, real estate, or content photography (or similar)

- Expert-level skills in Adobe Photoshop and Lightroom

- Confident with flambient blending, object removal, and sky replacement techniques

- Experience editing and retouching people and headshot photography

- A sharp eye for detail, composition, light, and colour — and a knack for natural, realistic edits

- Highly organised, deadline-driven, and comfortable managing multiple projects and high volumes of work

- Clear, professional and excellent English written communication

- Happy working independently as part of a distributed team

- Bonus points for experience training or mentoring other editors, familiarity with virtual staging, or a Cert IV/Diploma in Photography & Digital Imaging



The Details

Clique Creative is based in Adelaide, South Australia. This is a work-from-home role, so you'll need your own reliable computer and software setup - but your working hours will need to align with Adelaide time, 9am–5pm Monday to Friday (adjusting accordingly during daylight savings). We're after someone flexible and adaptable, ready to grow with us as our team and offering evolve.



Sound like you? We'd love to hear from you - apply today and help us create some of the best architectural and content imagery in the industry.

title: Customer service
description:

description:

The Amazon Brand Strategist will oversee brand positioning, product performance, and marketing strategy across Amazon marketplaces. This role requires a blend of analytical thinking, creative direction, and marketplace expertise to drive visibility, conversion, and profitability. The strategist will act as the brand guardian on Amazon—ensuring listings, imagery, pricing, and messaging reflect our brand identity while meeting performance targets.

________________________________________

• Analyze category trends, competitors, and consumer behavior to identify opportunities for new product launches or repositioning.

• Understanding of AI models and how to utilities them for meaningful growth

Listing Optimization & Content

• Oversee listing creation, A+ content, brand storefronts, and enhanced brand assets.

title: PPC Advertising Expert – Amazon, Walmart & Social Media
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced and analytical PPC Advertising Expert to manage and scale paid advertising campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Meta, TikTok, and Google platforms.

This role demands a blend of data-driven decision-making, creative testing, and strategic optimization to maximize ROI and brand visibility. The ideal candidate understands both marketplace algorithms and consumer behavior—capable of driving traffic, conversions, and sustained profitability.

________________________________________

Key Responsibilities

Amazon & Walmart Advertising

• Plan, execute, and optimize Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, Sponsored Display, and DSP campaigns.

• Manage Walmart Connect ads including search, display, and retargeting.

• Continuously analyze keyword performance, bids, and budgets to improve ACOS, ROAS, and TACOS.

• Implement strategies for new product launches, seasonal pushes, and liquidation campaigns.

• Monitor category trends, competitor ads, and pricing to identify growth opportunities.

Social Media & Paid Traffic

• Develop and manage Meta 
/Instagram), TikTok, and Google Ads campaigns to support brand awareness and conversion goals.

• Build and test creative variations for audience segments using dynamic ad formats, video, and carousel creatives.

• Coordinate with the creative and social media teams to ensure ad messaging aligns with brand voice and product positioning.

• Implement pixel tracking, conversion events, and retargeting funnels.

Analytics & Reporting

• Track, measure, and report daily/weekly/monthly campaign performance.

• Provide actionable insights using tools like Amazon Brand Analytics, Helium10, DataDive, Google Analytics, and Meta Ads Manager.

• Maintain clear documentation of testing outcomes, ad structures, and learnings for continuous improvement.

• Forecast advertising spend and ROI based on historical performance and growth goals.

Collaboration & Strategy

• Partner with the content and design teams to ensure compelling, conversion-focused creatives.

• Work with product and inventory teams to coordinate ad pacing with available stock and seasonality.

• Advise leadership on marketplace advertising trends, new ad types, and emerging automation tools.

________________________________________

Qualifications

• 3+ years of hands-on experience managing PPC campaigns (Amazon required; Walmart & Meta preferred).

• Proven track record of improving ROAS, scaling profitable campaigns, and managing high-budget ad accounts.

• Expert knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Walmart Connect, and Meta Ads Manager.

• Strong analytical skills and advanced proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets.

• Familiarity with AI-driven ad tools (e.g., Perpetua, Pacvue, Intentwise, or Klevu) is a plus.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills — able to translate data into strategy.

• History of working with strong USA based brands

________________________________________

Preferred Skills

• Experience in home textiles, décor, or lifestyle products.

• Creative mindset with strong understanding of A/B testing and consumer psychology.

• Working knowledge of automation tools and dashboards (Power BI, Looker Studio).

• Understanding of MAP pricing policies and brand protection.

________________________________________

Compensation

• Competitive salary based on experience

• Performance-based bonus structure

title: Social Media Content Production Specialist
description:
We're Hiring: Social Media Content Production Specialist (Part-Time)

Help Us Bring Hope and Healing to Thousands Around the World

Do you love creating meaningful social media content? Are you skilled with Canva, CapCut, ChatGPT, and short-form video creation?Would you enjoy helping build a Christian ministry dedicated to emotional healing, healthy relationships, and hope after heartbreak? If so, we'd love to hear from you.





ABOUT US:

Healed To Love Again is a Christian ministry committed to helping people heal from heartbreak, recover emotionally, strengthen their faith, and prepare for healthier future relationships. Through social media, books, podcasts, articles, and other digital resources, we share practical and biblically grounded encouragement with people around the world. As our ministry grows, we're looking for someone who can become an important part of our long-term content team.





ABOUT THE POSITION

- This Is NOT a Traditional Virtual Assistant Role

- We are not looking for someone to simply upload posts or perform administrative tasks.

- Instead, we're looking for someone who can take our ideas and transform them into engaging, high-quality social media content.

- Think of yourself as part of our Content Production Team.

- You won't be expected to invent our message.



Our founders will provide:

* Weekly content topics

* Key teaching points

* Supporting Bible verses

* Emotional direction

* Brand guidelines



Your role is to transform those ideas into beautiful, engaging content.



WHAT YOU'LL DO EACH WEEK

Every Monday, you'll attend a short planning meeting where you'll receive five content topics for the week.

For each topic, you'll create:



- One short-form Reel 
 / Instagram / TikTok)

- One quote graphic in Canva

- One social media post

- One Story sequence



After approval, you'll:



- Schedule content across our platforms

- Organize project files

- Update the content calendar

- Prepare a simple weekly analytics report



You'll also help us improve our content system over time by suggesting workflow improvements and using tools effectively.



TOOLS YOU'LL USE

We're looking for someone who is comfortable using AI and modern content creation tools.

Preferred experience includes:



* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

* Google Drive

* Meta Business Suite

* TikTok Scheduler



Experience with Notion or Trello is a bonus.



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who is:

* Creative

* Organized

* Reliable

* Detail-oriented

* Comfortable using AI

* Willing to learn

* Able to meet deadlines

* Open to feedback

* Interested in building long-term systems rather than simply completing tasks



REQUIRED SKILLS

* Excellent written English

* Canva

* CapCut

* Basic graphic design

* Short-form video editing

* Social media copywriting

* ChatGPT prompting

* Content organization



BONUS SKILLS

Experience creating content for:

* Christian ministries

* Coaches

* Authors

* Personal brands

* Relationship or mental wellness organizations



is an advantage but not required.



WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Every Friday, the following should be ready:



- 5 completed Reels

- 5 quote graphics

- 5 social media posts

- 5 Story sequences

- All content scheduled

- Organized project files

- Weekly analytics summary



As our systems improve, you'll also help us make our content production faster, smarter, and more efficient.



TRAINING & SUPPORT

You won't be starting from scratch.

We've already built detailed systems that you'll receive, including:



* Brand Guidelines

* Content Production SOPs

* Weekly Content Briefs

* AI Prompt Library

* Canva Templates

* CapCut Templates

* Content Calendar

* Workflow Documentation



Our goal is to help you succeed by providing clear systems and expectations.



COMPENSATION

* Part-time position

* Approximately 5–6 hours per week

* Competitive hourly rate based on experience



There is opportunity for increased hours and responsibility as the ministry grows.



OUR HIRING PROCESS

Our hiring process is in the following states

Stage 1 – Application,

Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment and 

Stage 3 – Interview

Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week



Stage 1 – Application

Please submit:

1. Your resume.

2. A link to your portfolio or examples of your work.

Examples may include:

* Reels

* Short-form videos

* Canva graphics

* Social media pages you've managed



3. Briefly tell us about your experience using:

* ChatGPT

* Canva

* CapCut

*

* Instagram

* TikTok



4. In 200 words or less:

How has AI changed the way you create content?



Stage 2 – Paid Practical Assignment

Shortlisted candidates will be invited to complete a **paid practical assignment** based on a real content topic from our ministry. This assignment is designed to reflect the actual work involved in the role.

Selected candidates will be compensated for their time.



Stage 3 – Interview

Finalists will participate in a short interview to discuss:

* Communication

* Organization

* Workflow

* Long-term goals

* Cultural fit



Stage 4 – Paid Trial Week

The successful candidate will complete a paid trial week, working through our real content production process.

This gives both you and our team the opportunity to determine whether we're a good long-term fit for one another.



PLEASE INCLUDE THE PHRASE "HIRING DEPARTMENT" within the subject of your application.



Why Join Us?

This is more than a freelance content role. It's an opportunity to help build a ministry that brings hope, healing, and biblical encouragement to people navigating some of life's most difficult seasons. If you're excited about creating meaningful content, leveraging AI to work smarter, and growing with a mission-driven team, we'd love to hear from you. We look forward to receiving your application.

title: Video Producer / Visual Content Creator for Online Rock Music Project
description:
I’m looking for a remote video producer to help create compelling visual content for an exciting new online Substack-based original music production project.



The project is in the early stages, so it offers great opportunities for additional responsibilities and wage increases for top performance as we grow.



You will collaborate closely with me to develop visual assets that bring original songs, livestreams, virtual concerts, and multimedia presentations to life through a combination of stock footage, AI-generated video, motion graphics, and creative visual storytelling.



The goal is to create engaging visual experiences for three things:

• Music videos for each of my original songs

• Visual backdrops for weekly music livestreams?

• Visual backdrops for virtual concert gigs at colleges, conferences, festivals, art house theaters, and other global venues?



The ideal candidate will be excited about helping build a unique music and multimedia brand by transforming original songs and livestream presentations into visually compelling experiences that attract, engage, and grow an audience.



==================================================

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:

==================================================



• Music Video Production: Create a finished music video for each completed original song using a combination of royalty-free stock footage, AI-generated video, motion graphics, and other creative visual techniques. (I will provide examples for training purposes.) 

• Livestream Visual Asset Creation: Design and produce looping background visuals, scene assets, animated elements, intro sequences, transitions, and other visual components used in my Ecamm Live-created Sunday livestreams and virtual concert presentations. (I will provide examples for training purposes.)

• Visual Storytelling & Creative Direction: Collaborate with me to develop visual concepts that support the emotional themes, lyrical content, and storytelling of original songs.

• Footage Sourcing & Asset Management: Locate and organize high-quality royalty-free footage from platforms such as Artlist and other approved sources. (I will provide and pay for the Artlist subscription.)

• AI Video Production: Utilize AI video generation platforms to create custom visual assets and sequences that cannot easily be sourced through stock footage.

• Ongoing Strategy Sessions: Help brainstorm new visual approaches, workflows, and technologies that can improve production quality while maintaining an efficient and scalable content creation process.



==================================================

CORE TRAITS I’M LOOKING FOR: 

==================================================



• Creativity, initiative, and strong visual storytelling instincts

• Promptness, honesty, reliability

• Strong written and verbal English communication skills

• Ability to work independently while collaborating closely with me on creative direction

• Curiosity and enthusiasm about emerging AI-powered creative tools

• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

• Love of music, visual arts, filmmaking, or creative media is a major plus

• Experience editing and producing videos for YouTube, social media, livestreams, music artists, brands, or other creative projects

• Ability to combine stock footage, AI-generated footage, motion graphics, text overlays, and visual effects into polished finished productions

• Experience working with royalty-free footage libraries

• Strong sense of pacing, mood, composition, and visual storytelling

• Comfortable receiving feedback and iterating quickly

• Communicative: You're not afraid to give ideas, voice opinions and feedback, and ask the right questions when anything is unclear

• Reliable internet connection



==================================================

WHAT YOU’LL BE DOING DAILY:

==================================================



You will work two hours a day, Monday through Friday. Each day you will work on one or more of the responsibilities listed above in the service of creating music videos, livestream visuals, virtual concert assets, and other multimedia content supporting audience growth and revenue generation.



Three times per week we’ll meet over Zoom for approximately one hour to review completed work, discuss upcoming projects, brainstorm creative ideas, and establish production priorities.



These Zoom sessions will likely be longer in the beginning as I train you on my music, creative vision, project history, and production goals, and shorter down the road as you become more familiar with the project and are able to take greater initiative.



==================================================

WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU: 

==================================================



• Get in at the ground level of a unique and innovative online original music venture

• A chance to help shape the visual identity and creative direction of a growing multimedia music project

• Hands-on experience working with both traditional video production and cutting-edge AI creative tools

• Long-term, stable remote work with the potential to expand scope and rate

• 2 hours a day, Monday – Friday (10 hours per week)

• Fully remote



==================================================

HOURS & COMPENSATION:

==================================================



• 2 hours a day, Monday - Friday (flexible, remote)

• Wage commensurate with experience



==================================================

APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

==================================================



1)  Make your subject line: Super Rock Project Video Producer – [Your Name]

2)  Include a brief summary of your experience creating video content. 

3)  Include the types of projects you've worked on, industries served, software used, and your role in the production process.

4)  Include links to your portfolio, demo reel, YouTube channel, Vimeo page, or any examples of work that best represent your abilities.

5)  Tell me which video editing, motion graphics, AI video generation, and creative platforms you currently use and your level of experience with each.

6)  Tell me what excites you about the prospect of helping build an original music project through music videos, livestream visuals, and multimedia storytelling.

7)  Describe your current work commitments and how many hours per week you have available



I look forward to hearing from you. 



Rock on… because music matters.

title: Financial Controller
description:
About the Role



We are a U.S.-based healthcare services company looking for a hands-on Controller to own our accounting close and financial reporting, bring our books to a state we can rely on, and lead a small, capable remote finance and operations team.



Today, most of our day-to-day operations run through an interconnected set of Google Sheets, while financial transactions are recorded in QuickBooks Online. We want a controller who can make QuickBooks the source of truth for financial reporting—producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet every month—while keeping our Google Sheets running smoothly as operational tools.



This is a role for someone who is both a strong accountant and a capable manager: comfortable making categorization and accounting judgment calls independently, and equally comfortable directing, reviewing, and developing a team.





Key Responsibilities



Accounting & Monthly Close





Own the monthly close and produce timely, accurate financial statements (P&L and balance sheet) in QuickBooks Online.

Establish and maintain QuickBooks as the company's financial source of truth, with Google Sheets used operationally.

Maintain the chart of accounts, class structure, and cost-of-goods-sold framework; make and document categorization decisions independently rather than escalating routine ones.

Prepare and post journal entries, including payroll allocations and owner draws/distributions.

Reconcile all funding channels: bank deposits, merchant processors, financing partners, ACH, and checks.





Cash Flow & Payroll





Prepare the weekly cash-flow forecast every Wednesday by 8:00 AM, covering transacted-but-undeposited revenue across all channels and upcoming obligations (payroll, vendors, financing).

Prepare and review weekly payroll for submission to our payroll processor. Final sign-off remains with ownership; you ensure it is accurate and ready.

Track commissions, bonuses, reserves, deferrals, and clawbacks accurately and transparently.





Expense Management & Internal Controls





Review corporate card activity against receipts and policy; flag personal or unapproved charges and manage clawbacks.

Build and enforce expense and card-usage policies, including documentation and approval standards.

Track refunds and chargebacks; put controls in place to prevent duplicate or erroneous refunds.

Oversee accounts receivable and collections, including payment follow-ups and tracking of uncollected sales.





Systems & Data Integrity





Maintain and safeguard our Google Sheets architecture (rep workbooks, master sales sheet, weekly P&L/payroll, cash-flow analysis, bonus and scoring trackers), including formula integrity, cross-sheet links, and range protection.

Standardize recurring processes and document clear SOPs.

Help evaluate and, where feasible, support a future migration of recordkeeping toward more integrated tooling or a CRM.





Team Leadership





Manage, direct, and develop a three-person remote finance/operations team.

Assign and prioritize work, review deliverables for accuracy and completeness, and ensure deadlines are met.

Establish and monitor productivity and time-tracking standards; hold the team accountable for both hours worked and output delivered.

Serve as the first point of resolution for day-to-day questions, reducing escalations to ownership.





Reporting & Stakeholders





Produce financial reports for ownership and, when needed, for prospective partners or lenders.

Communicate proactively and clearly in writing, primarily via Slack and
.







What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)





QuickBooks cleaned up to the point of producing an accurate P&L and balance sheet.

Reliable weekly cash-flow forecast and payroll, with minimal ownership involvement in routine categorization.

A documented categorization ruleset and a basic internal-controls/expense-policy framework.

A clear, accurate handle on team workload, output quality, and hours.







Required Qualifications





5+ years of progressive accounting/bookkeeping experience, including ownership of a monthly close.

Advanced QuickBooks Online skills (chart of accounts, classes, journal entries, COGS).

Strong Google Sheets ability: complex formulas (e.g., QUERY, IMPORTRANGE, ARRAYFORMULA) and the ability to debug and maintain a system of linked workbooks.

Demonstrated experience managing a team (remote experience preferred).

Excellent written English and a schedule with significant overlap with U.S. business hours.

High integrity, strong attention to detail, and a proactive, ownership mindset.





Preferred (Nice to Have)





CPA (Philippine CPA) or equivalent credential.

U.S. GAAP familiarity (accrual accounting, contra-revenue, COGS treatment).

Experience with payroll processors (e.g., ADP), AP/AR and ACH platforms (e.g., 
), corporate card platforms (e.g., Divvy, Amex), and merchant/financing processors.

Experience evaluating or implementing a CRM (e.g., GoHighLevel).







Tools You'll Use



QuickBooks Online · Google Sheets · ADP ·

Reporting & Authority

Manages the three-person finance/operations team.

title: Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator
description:
We are a U.S.-based private money lending company that provides short-term, asset-based loans to real estate investors. We focus on first- and second-position loans, bridge funding, gap funding, and creative real estate transactions.

We value clean execution, capital protection, and professional communication.



Role Overview

We are hiring a Loan Processor / Lending Operations Coordinator to run borrower intake, manage our loan pipeline, and prepare deal files for underwriting. This role is the operational backbone of our lending business and works directly with borrowers, brokers, and internal leadership.



This is not a bank mortgage role. You will support private money and creative real estate deals using a CRM pipeline (GoHighLevel) and documented internal SOPs.



Key Responsibilities



Borrower Intake & Pipeline Management

Respond to new borrower applications and CRM inquiries the same business day

Send first-touch outreach to all new borrower leads promptly

Follow up consistently to collect missing application items

Accurately track and update borrower status through the correct CRM pipeline stages

Keep the pipeline clean — no stale files, no unanswered leads

Flag urgent or high-priority deals for leadership without delay





Loan File Organization & Documentation

Create and maintain borrower folders in Google Drive per company naming conventions

Collect ALL required documents before escalating a file: purchase agreement, rehab budget/scope of work, ARV comps, property photos, borrower ID, LLC documents (Operating Agreement + proof of good standing), verified HUDs, insurance, and a clearly stated exit strategy

Track all documents and file status accurately in the CRM

Submit complete, clearly labeled files that are ready for underwriting





SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification

Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid)

Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements

Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP

Escalate unclear or borderline deals to leadership — never force a file through



Communication & Reporting



Provide consistent daily end-of-day (EOD) updates: completed, pending, needs attention

Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process

Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked

Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly



Important Authority Boundaries



You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership.

Requirements



2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support

Strong attention to detail and organization

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients

Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups

Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems

Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience

Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy)

Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin)

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



What Success Looks Like



Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered

Deals move smoothly with minimal rework

Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting

Borrowers feel informed and supported

Leadership does not need to fix or chase files



Growth Path



Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.

title: Medical Billing & Coding Specialist – Pain Management / eCW / Denials – Full-Time
description:
**Medical Billing & Coding Specialist – Pain Management / eCW / Denials – Full-Time**



We are a U.S.-based interventional pain management medical clinic looking for a reliable, experienced **Medical Billing & Coding Specialist** to join our team full-time.



This is a long-term role for someone who understands U.S. medical billing, denials, payer follow-up, corrected claims, EOB review, and coding issues. This is not a general virtual assistant position.



The role is approximately:



**70% billing, denials, AR follow-up, and payer communication**

**30% coding review and claim accuracy support**



Our top priorities are:



1. Prevent coding and modifier mistakes before claims go out.

2. Work old AR, denials, EOBs, corrected claims, payer calls, and appeal preparation.



**About our clinic**



We are a U.S. pain management practice. We perform interventional pain procedures, office visits, medication management, injections, fluoroscopy-guided procedures, ultrasound-guided procedures, and other specialty services. We need someone who can help us improve billing accuracy, reduce denials, and follow through on claims until they are paid or properly resolved.



**Required experience**



You must have experience with U.S. medical billing.



Strongly preferred:



* Pain management billing or coding experience

* Orthopedic, spine, anesthesia, PM&R, surgery center, or specialty billing experience

* eClinicalWorks experience

* Denial management experience

* Corrected claims experience

* Payer portal experience

* EOB/ERA review experience

* Insurance phone call experience



Certification is preferred but not required.



Preferred certifications include CPC, COC, CCS-P, CCS, RHIT, RHIA, or similar U.S. medical coding certification. However, real-world U.S. pain management billing/coding experience is more important than certification alone.



**Responsibilities**



You will help with:



* Reviewing claims before submission for obvious coding, modifier, or documentation issues

* Working old AR

* Reviewing EOBs and denial reasons

* Calling payers and documenting call reference numbers

* Checking payer portals

* Preparing corrected claims

* Preparing appeal/reconsideration notes

* Identifying repeat denial patterns

* Escalating coding or documentation problems before claims are sent

* Working with our biller and physician on difficult claims

* Helping create internal billing/coding notes and cheat sheets

* Making sure claims are not written off incorrectly without review



**Examples of areas we work with**



Pain management and specialty coding may include office visits, injections, epidurals, medial branch blocks, radiofrequency ablation, SI joint procedures, genicular procedures, trigger point injections, joint injections, fluoroscopy, ultrasound guidance, sedation, urine drug testing, J-codes, modifiers, bundled codes, and payer-specific denial rules.



You do not need to know everything on day one, but you must have strong U.S. billing fundamentals and be able to learn quickly.



**Schedule**



This is a full-time position.



You must be available live during U.S. Central Time business hours.



You must be responsive during scheduled work hours through our communication system.



**Pay**



$8–$12 USD per hour depending on experience, skill level, eCW experience, pain management experience, and reliability.



**Important: No overemployment**



We are looking for someone who is dedicated and reliable.



During your scheduled work hours, you must work only for our clinic. You may not work another job, take other client calls, perform tasks for another employer, outsource your work, share your login, or allow anyone else to access our systems.

Competitive Compensation: Starting at $400 AUD per week for just 2 days of work.



Creative Freedom: Work with award-winning, high-budget campaigns and beautiful cinematic assets alongside a supportive, modern team.



Work-Life Balance: A genuine part-time, 2-day work week to keep your creative battery fully charged and allow you time for other pursuits.

 us at

title: Takeoff Estimator — HVAC / Refrigeration
description:

- Quantity takeoffs fro
chanical / HVAC drawings:

Nice to have

- HVAC estimating software (Trimble AutoBid, FastDUCT/FastPIPE, MagiCAD).

- Mechanical / refrigeration trade knowledge.



Pay

Paid per project. Starts with a paid trial (one takeoff). Ongoing work for the right person.



How to apply — read carefully (I skip anyone who doesn't)

1. Start your message with the word DUCT.

2. In 3–4 lines: the biggest HVAC/mechanical job you've taken off, and what you measured.

3. Attach one takeoff or sample of your work.

title: Amazon Product Sourcing & Research | China Negotiation | 3+ Years PL Experience
description:
Who We Are

BTS Brands is an 8-year-old private label company selling across US, CA, UK, EU, AU, JP and expanding into Saudi Arabia. We operate across two brands - one in the travel accessories category and one in beauty devices - with 52+ active SKUs.



We're not a startup figuring things out - we have systems, a team, and a clear direction. What we need now is someone senior who can take full ownership of product development for one of our brands while we scale.



The Role

This is not a VA role. This is a specialist position for someone who has done this before and can work independently.

You will own the full product lifecycle for one brand: from identifying opportunities, to negotiating with Chinese suppliers on WeChat, to making sure samples, timelines, packaging, and user manuals are all on track before launch. You'll also do product research for our second brand.

You'll work closely with our marketing and design team, and report directly to the owner.



What You'll Do Daily:

- Conduct product research across Amazon marketplaces (US/CA/UK/EU/AU/JP)

- Analyze competition, demand, pricing, and profitability (ROI, FBA fees, net margin)

- Communicate directly with Chinese suppliers via WeChat - negotiate pricing, MOQs, timelines

- Request and evaluate samples, coordinate quality checks

- Monitor production timelines and flag delays before they become problems

- Review packaging and user manuals for compliance (not copy, just accuracy)

- Calculate profitability at every stage before committing to a launch

- Collaborate with marketing and graphic design teams on launch prep

- Report weekly with recommendations and progress updates



Tools You Must Know:

- Helium 10 (Cerebro, Black Box, Xray, Keyword Tracker)

- Keepa - price history, trends, seasonality

- Amazon Seller Central - BSR, sales data interpretation

- Alibaba + WeChat - supplier sourcing and negotiation

- Google Sheets / Excel - ROI models, dashboards, profitability trackers

- Jungle Scout - a plus



Who We're Looking For:

- 3–5 years experience in Amazon Private Label product development and sourcing

- You've negotiated directly with Chinese suppliers - not just browsed Alibaba

- You think in numbers: margins, costs, lead times, risks

- You communicate clearly in English, written and verbal

- You're organized and proactive - you chase timelines, you don't wait to be chased

- You want a long-term role with room to grow, not a short contract



Compensation & Setup:

- $1,000–$1,400/month based on experience

- Full-time, 40h/week

- 14 days paid leave after 3 months

- First 3 months: time-tracked via Time Doctor (removed after we establish trust)

- Long-term position - We Invest in People Who Invest in Us



Important

This role is for one of our brands that currently has no team. You'll be building from the ground up with clear direction from ownership. If you need someone to micromanage your daily tasks, this isn't the right fit. If you thrive with clear objectives and autonomy, keep reading.





To Apply - Required

Answer these 4 questions. Applications without answers will not be considered:



1. Describe a product you sourced from a Chinese supplier, how did you find them, how did you negotiate, and what was the final outcome? Include the platform you used to find them (Alibaba, WeChat, trade show etc.), the MOQ you negotiated, and one specific thing that almost went wrong. Do not describe what you would do - describe what you actually did.

2. Walk me through your evaluation process for a Private Label product - what metrics matter most to you, what makes you say no, and what makes you say yes? Give a real example without naming the product. What's your process, not your tools.

3. What tools do you use daily for Amazon product research, and rate your confidence in each from 1 to 10. For the tool you rated highest - walk me through one specific thing you do in it that most people skip or don't know about.

4. What's the biggest mistake you've seen (or made) in product development, and what did you change after? Be specific.

title: Amazon Listing Growth Specialist (DataDive Expert Required)
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job.  You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.  



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.  

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.  









We are looking for a senior Amazon listing operator who knows how to launch, rank, and scale products on Amazon — not just write copy. You live inside DataDive, Helium 10, and Brand Analytics, and you can read a niche the way most people read a book.



You will own the full lifecycle of our Amazon listings: from keyword research and competitive analysis on day one, through launch, ranking, and ongoing optimization. You will be responsible for the data-driven decisions that move our products up the page.



You are the person who answers every week:

• “Which keywords are we winning, losing, or missing?”

• “Why did this listing drop in rank?”

• “What is the next listing we should optimize, and why?”

• “Where is the next growth opportunity in this category?”



What You Will Own

Keyword Research & Competitive Analysis

• Run deep keyword research in DataDive (Cerebro-style reverse ASIN, competitor gap analysis, keyword opportunity scoring)

• Build keyword master lists segmented by priority, search volume, relevance, and competition

• Identify untapped long-tail and high-intent keywords competitors are missing

• Analyze competitor listings, reviews, pricing, and ranking patterns

• Map the competitive landscape for every product line

New Listing Launch

• Build SEO-optimized titles, bullets, descriptions, and backend search terms

• Write A+ Content briefs and Brand Story modules

• Coordinate image and infographic briefs with the design team

• Develop launch strategy: pricing, coupons, vine, PPC seeding, and ranking plan

• Set up parent/child variations correctly the first time

• Track launch performance against ranking and revenue targets



Ongoing Listing Optimization

• Audit existing listings for keyword gaps, indexing issues, and conversion leaks

• Run structured A/B tests on titles, main images, and copy using Manage Your Experiments

• Monitor keyword rank movements and respond to ranking drops fast

• Refresh listings based on seasonality, trends, and new competitor moves

• Improve conversion rate, session-to-purchase ratio, and click-through rate



Brand Analytics & Seller Central Intelligence

• Pull and interpret Search Query Performance, Top Search Terms, and Market Basket reports

• Identify share-of-voice gaps vs. top competitors in each category

• Track conversion share, click share, and purchase share by keyword

• Use Seller Central data to validate or challenge DataDive findings

• Flag listing health issues: suppressions, Buy Box loss, policy warnings, stranded inventory



Reporting & Dashboards



You will build and maintain:

• Weekly keyword rank tracker (organic and sponsored)

• Listing health scorecard by ASIN

• Competitor watchlist with movement alerts

• Launch performance reports vs. plan

• Optimization backlog with projected impact and priority



Who You Are



You are not a generalist Amazon VA. You are:

• A senior Amazon operator who has launched and scaled real products — not just edited listings

• A true DataDive power user (this is non-negotiable)

• Deeply analytical — you make decisions from data, not from gut feel

• Obsessive about keyword indexing, ranking, and conversion

• Comfortable reading Search Query Performance reports and explaining what they mean

• Up to date on Amazon algorithm changes, policy updates, and category trends

• A strong written communicator who can brief designers, copywriters, and leadership clearly

• Self-directed — you bring opportunities to the table, you don’t wait to be told



Required Experience

• 5+ years managing Amazon listings at a senior or lead level

• Proven track record of launching products and ranking them on page 1 for competitive keywords

• Expert-level proficiency in DataDive (required — we will test this)

• Strong working knowledge of Helium 10 (Cerebro, Magnet, Frankenstein, Index Checker)

• Hands-on experience with Brand Analytics and Seller Central reporting

• Experience writing high-converting Amazon copy and A+ Content briefs

• Experience running Manage Your Experiments (A/B tests) on titles and images

• Strong spreadsheet skills (pivots, lookups, basic modeling)

• Familiarity with Amazon Ads / PPC concepts (you don’t need to run campaigns, but you need to understand them)



What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full keyword and competitor audit completed for every active ASIN

• Prioritized optimization backlog built and in motion

• At least one major listing relaunch with measurable rank and conversion lift

• Weekly reporting cadence established with leadership

• Clear launch playbook documented for future product releases



Why This Role Matters

Amazon is a zero-sum game. For every rank position we don’t own, a competitor does. The right person in this seat directly drives revenue — every keyword you win, every conversion point you add, and every launch you nail compounds over months and years.



How to Apply



Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• A specific example of a listing you launched or optimized, with the keyword(s) you targeted and the rank/revenue result

• How long you have used DataDive and what you use it for most

• One Amazon listing mistake you see most operators make — and how you avoid it

title: Video Editor (Paid Ad Creatives)
description:
Hey there! We're Hest Enterprises — an eCommerce brand that is scaling globally.



We're looking for a Video Editor to join our fast growing team.



Your mission? Collaborate with our Creative Strategist & Copywriter to produce ad creatives that actually convert and help scale our brands to multiple 7 figures+.



Important! If you have zero interest in learning why ads work (not just making them look pretty), this role isn't for you. But if you're hungry to learn marketing while sharpening your editing skills...



Who We're Looking For



One golden rule at our company: you must have the DESIRE to learn & grow. If you're not passionate about getting better every week, this isn't the place for you.



The purpose of this role isn't just editing videos — it's learning how to edit for performance. You'll learn how hooks grab attention, how emotional pacing drives watch time, and how the right angle maximizes ROAS. We'll train you on the marketing side — you bring the hunger.



You're a great fit if you:



- Love editing videos and want to get seriously good at it

- Are curious about what makes ads actually convert

- Take feedback well and move fast on revisions

- Are organized, reliable, and detail-oriented

- Want to grow into a Creative Strategist role over time (not necessary)



What You'll Do Day-to-Day



- Edit short-form video ads (UGC, product clips, b-roll)

- Assemble ads using provided scripts, briefs, and reference examples

- Add text overlays, captions, cuts, and pacing optimized for ads

- Create variations from the same core footage for testing

- Help document ad structure in simple briefs (hook, message, CTA)

- Make revisions based on internal feedback

- Keep files and exports organized for the team

- Attend weekly learning check-ins



Required:



- Experience with Video Editing ads (CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar)

- Clear written English

- Ability to follow instructions and hit deadlines

- Open & Curious to Feedback and Revisions

- Organised and reliable



Why Join Us?



- Bonuses & Profit Share — You'll earn bonuses tied to the performance of ads you help create. When your work converts, you get rewarded.

- Real Training — Not just video editing. We'll train you on ad structures, creative strategy, and how to edit for results. You'll learn marketing fundamentals most junior editors never get exposed to.

- Growth Path — There's a clear path from Junior Editor ? Creative Strategist based on performance. We promote from within.



How Does This Work?



We hold our team to high standards and reward great work — expect your rates to grow as you do. Here's our simple hiring process:



- Send a short intro video about yourself and your experience,

- A portfolio or samples of video edits (ads preferred)

- Culture and Values Interview

- Complete a quick editing assessment tailored for the role

- Final interview with our Founder to discuss fit and finalize an offer



If this resonates with you, let's chat! Choose the number of the core value you feel aligns with you most and include it in your application:



1 - RESULTS OBSESSED

2 - ATTENTION TO DETAIL

3 - ACCELERATED EXCELLENCE

4 - RELENTLESS OWNERSHIP

5 - PREPARED TO WIN

6 - COLLABORATIVE INNOVATION

7 - NEVER NOT GROWING



Apply now and let's grow together!

You’ll be part of the engine that keeps our day-to-day running smoothly - supporting our customers, organizing backend operations, and helping us improve how we work as we scale.

Instead, you’ll be part of the team, learning across different areas of the business, gaining new skills, and building something meaningful together.

If we’re going to do something, we do it with care and pride.

We find meaning in the work we do - and how we do it.

We believe everything can be learned. And we’re committed to growing together, day by day.

At the end of this onboarding and probation phase, if we’re aligned and excited to move forward together, your position will be confirmed as a full-time tea
mber - with continued mentorship, support, and a clear path for growth ahead.

Ready to be part of something exciting?

Apply now - we can’t wait to meet you!

title: Marketplace Multichannel specialist
description:
If you are unable to provide references from actual brands in the USA with whom we can speak to discuss your previous performance, please do not apply for this job. You will be wasting your time and it will also tell us you have not read the description.



Requirements:



This job is for Pacific Standard Time - 8 AM - 430 PM with some OT expected during peak times.

Time doctor use is mandatory.

Growth Mindset and leadership approach.



About the Role

We are looking for a multi-channel listing specialist who can build, launch, and optimize product listings across five very different marketplaces: Shopify, Walmart, Target, eBay, and Wayfair.

This is a listings-focused role. You will not be running ads or managing inventory sync — your job is to make sure every product we sell shows up clean, accurate, optimized, and conversion-ready on every channel where it lives.

You understand that each marketplace plays by its own rules. Shopify gives you total creative control. Walmart and Target demand strict content compliance and category-specific attribute precision. eBay rewards keyword density and item specifics. Wayfair is its own world of merchandising, dimensions, and class-level requirements. You know how to switch contexts and execute correctly on all five.

You are the person who asks every week:

• “Which listings are underperforming, and on which channel?”

• “Where are we missing keywords, attributes, or images?”

• “Which listings are flagged, suppressed, or non-compliant?”

• “Where is the biggest optimization opportunity this week?”

What You Will Own

Shopify

• Build product pages with SEO-optimized titles, descriptions, and meta data

• Manage collections, tags, and product organization

• Configure variants, options, and inventory display

• Optimize images, alt text, and structured data for search

• Coordinate with design team on PDP layout, badges, and on-page assets

Walmart Marketplace

• Create and maintain item setups via Item Spec or bulk upload

• Optimize titles, key features, descriptions, and rich media

• Ensure full attribute completeness (Walmart’s Listing Quality Score)

• Manage category-specific compliance and content scorecards

• Resolve content errors, item processing failures, and unpublished items

Target Plus

• Build item setup files following Target’s strict content guidelines

• Write titles and copy that match Target’s brand voice and guest tone

• Manage attribute completeness, images, and enhanced content

• Work within Target Plus Partners portal to maintain item status

• Coordinate item approval and resubmission workflows

eBay

• Build listings with optimized titles (80-character usage) and complete item specifics

• Write keyword-rich descriptions structured for eBay’s search algorithm

• Use eBay’s product catalog and category-specific required fields correctly

• Manage variation listings, store categories, and promotional content

• Monitor and improve listing quality, search visibility, and Best Match positioning

Wayfair

• Build product feeds with accurate class, dimensions, materials, and merchandising attributes

• Write Wayfair-style titles, marketing copy, and bullet features that convert in their PDP layout

• Manage image requirements, lifestyle imagery, and dimension diagrams

• Resolve content rejection issues and class-level data gaps

• Maintain product data quality scores within the Wayfair Partner Home dashboard

Cross-Channel Quality & Reporting

• Maintain a master content library so titles, copy, images, and attributes stay consistent across channels

• Adapt content to each channel’s rules — never copy-paste the same listing everywhere

• Audit existing listings on every channel for gaps, errors, and optimization opportunities

• Track listing health and content scorecards on every platform

• Build a weekly status report showing active, pending, suppressed, and flagged listings by channel

Who You Are

You are not a generalist VA. You are:

• A multi-channel listing operator who has worked in at least 3 of these 5 platforms hands-on

• Fluent in the language of product data: titles, attributes, item specifics, taxonomy, GTINs, variants

• Detail-obsessed — a missing attribute or wrong category is a personal offense

• A strong writer who can shift tone between Shopify, Target, eBay, and Wayfair without thinking about it

• Comfortable working inside multiple seller portals every day

• Calm under spreadsheet pressure — you can manage hundreds of SKUs without losing track

• Self-directed — you flag issues, propose fixes, and execute without hand-holding

Required Experience

• 3+ years building and optimizing product listings on marketplaces and Shopify

• Hands-on experience in at least 3 of the following: Shopify, Walmart Marketplace, Target Plus, eBay, Wayfair

• Working knowledge of marketplace content quality requirements and scorecards

• Strong copywriting skills for product titles, bullets, and descriptions

• Comfortable with bulk uploads, item setup templates, and feed files (CSV / Excel)

• Strong spreadsheet skills (formulas, lookups, pivots)

• Working knowledge of product taxonomy, GTINs, UPCs, and category attribute structures

• Experience coordinating with design teams on image requirements per channel

What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)

• Full content audit completed across all 5 channels

• Master content library built and maintained as source of truth

• Prioritized optimization backlog in motion, by channel

• Listing quality scores improved on Walmart, Target, and Wayfair

• Weekly multi-channel status report established with leadership

• Clear playbook documented for launching a new product across all 5 channels

Why This Role Matters

Every channel we sell on is a storefront, and every storefront is judged on its weakest listing. The right person in this seat protects our brand, lifts conversion across the board, and turns five marketplaces into five well-run businesses instead of five neglected ones.

Work Hours

Monday through Friday, Pacific Standard Time.

How to Apply

Send your resume and a short note that includes:

• Which of the 5 channels you have the most experience on, and how long

• A specific listing you built or optimized — what you changed, and the result

• The biggest difference, in your view, between writing a Shopify product page and a Walmart listing

title: UGC Video Editor - Ecommerce
description:
Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)







UGC EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

AGENCY EXPERIENCE PREFERRED



About Us

We're a company running 7–8 figure DTC brand portfolios operating across the US, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Our growth runs through paid social - Meta and TikTok at a serious scale, which means video is at the center of everything we do. We produce a high volume of UGC-style and direct-response ad creative, and we need editors who can keep up without the output quality slipping.



This isn't a passion project or a content agency. The videos we edit run as paid ads, and the numbers tell us immediately what's working and what isn't. If you're the kind of editor who gets better with every round of feedback and wants to understand why something performs, not just how it looks, this is the environment for you.

We operate across multiple brands and categories, which means if needed, our editors must have the ability to switch between brand voices and audience types without losing quality or pace.

 

The Role

You'll be editing video content primarily for paid social - UGC ads, direct-response creatives, product-focused content, AI visuals generation, and repurposed organic clips across Meta and TikTok. You'll work from briefs and raw footage provided by our creative strategists and UGC creators, and you'll be expected to turn around polished, platform-ready ads at a reliable pace.

This is a high-output, high-feedback role. You'll be part of a structured creative production workflow, briefs, revisions, performance reviews and the feedback you get will be based on how the content actually performs, not just how it looks.

 

What You'll Be Doing

Core Editing

•    Editing UGC-style and direct-response video ads from raw footage – fast edits [minimum 1.5sec-2 seconds frame changes on visuals], aggressive visuals, clean cuts when needed, strong pacing, and hooks that don't lose the viewer in the first three seconds

•    Applying motion graphics, captions, text overlays, sound design, and music to produce platform-ready content across Meta and TikTok

•    Working from creative briefs and script references you follow the direction but you also bring your eye to it

•    Producing multiple versions of the same concept (hook tests, CTA variations, format cuts) efficiently

Workflow & Collaboration

•    Receiving and interpreting briefs from creative strategists - asking smart questions upfront rather than going back and forth after the first cut

•    Submitting first cuts on time and responding to revision notes quickly and accurately

•    Staying current on UGC trends, editing styles, and platform-native formats and flagging when you see something worth testing

•    Keeping your project files, exports, and asset folders organized according to team SOPs

•    Supporting the team in repurposing high-performing content into new formats when needed

 

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

•    A strong portfolio of edited video ads -  UGC, direct-response, or DTC brand content; we want to see cuts that are designed to perform, not just look good

•    Proficiency in Premiere Pro and/or CapCut - you can work fast in whichever tool the project calls for

•    Strong sense of pacing - you know when a cut is too slow, when a hook is burying itself, and when to trim

•    Understanding of how paid social video works: hook structure, attention retention, CTA placement, and format differences between Meta and TikTok

•    Reliable output - you can handle multiple concurrent edits and hit deadlines consistently

•    Receptive to feedback, revision rounds are part of the job; taking notes personally isn't

Strong Advantages

•    Experience editing DTC, beauty, wellness, or lifestyle brand content

•    Motion graphics skills , text animations, transitions, lower thirds that go beyond basic templates

•    Experience with AI-assisted editing tools that improve turnaround without sacrificing quality

•    Understanding of what makes a winning ad not just technically clean editing, but structurally effective storytelling

•    Familiarity with the UGC content model and how to make creator footage feel polished without losing authenticity

Instant No's

•    Your portfolio is full of cinematic, long-form, or brand film content with no paid social or direct-response work we're not doing that here

•    You need heavy direction on every edit

•    You treat revision notes as optional suggestions - revisions exist to make the content perform better, and accuracy matters

•    You can't sustain output at volume - this is a high-output environment and pace is part of the job

 

What the First 90 Days Look Like

First 30 Days

•    Complete onboarding: brand immersion, SOP walkthrough, file structure orientation, and creative review process

•    Shadow existing edit requests to understand the standard we hold our output to

•    Begin editing live briefs and establish reliable turnaround time and revision accuracy from day one

60 Days

•    Editing independently with minimal back-and-forth, at this time, you've internalized the brief format and the quality bar

•    Operating at full output capacity across concurrent projects

90 Days

•    A trusted, high-output editor the team doesn't need to micromanage

•    Actively contributing to creative iteration and not just executing briefs but improving them

•    Clear track record of on-time delivery, accurate revisions, and consistent quality

•    Positioned for growth toward a Senior Editor role as the team scales

 

How We Measure Your Performance

•    Output volume - number of completed edits per week against targets

•    Revision rate - how many rounds does it take to get to final approval

•    Turnaround time - from brief receipt to first cut submission

•    Creative contribution - are you bringing ideas, flagging trends, and improving the briefs you receive

•    Ad performance - over time, do the edits you produce correlate with stronger results and are you getting winning ads

 

Compensation & Benefits

•    Competitive monthly rate (contractor) based on experience and portfolio quality

•    Clear growth path: Video Editor ? Senior Video Editor

•    Fully remote - no fixed location, flexible setup

•    Learning & development budget

•    Access to winning ad references and a structured feedback system that actually makes you better

•    Exposure to high-volume, multi-market DTC creative production at real scale

•    Weekly performance reviews with the Creative Director

 

???? We produce a lot of content and we move fast. If you thrive in a structured creative environment where your work gets tested against real numbers and you want to get genuinely better at your craft this is a strong place to be.



Hiring Process

1. Fill out form: (ADD PORFOLIO IN FORM, NO PORTFOLIO = APPLICATION NOT ACCEPTED)



2. Once screened, you'll do skills assessment test

3. Interview

title: Brand & Content Strategist - Content Creator & Reels Editor (Social Media | Credit, Fitness & Motivation)
description:
WHO WE ARE



We are a growing personal brand built around three core pillars: credit repair and business funding, real estate acquisition, and an authentic lifestyle presence spanning fitness, renovations, and entrepreneurship. The brand is built around a real person with a real story — quiet, intentional, results-driven. The content needs to reflect that identity while commanding serious attention online.

THE ROLE



We are looking for a Brand and Content Strategist who does not wait to be told what to do. You understand how attention works online — not just what looks good, but what builds an audience, drives consistent visibility, and keeps potential clients thinking about this brand between posts. You think in campaigns, not content pieces. You think in growth, not output.



This is a gig and internship opportunity with a clearly defined path to a full-time salaried role at the six-month mark for the right person. If you are looking for a short-term freelance gig, this is not it. If you are looking to build something from the ground up alongside a founder who is serious about scaling — read on.



You will execute the content yourself while bringing the strategy that drives it. You are both the architect and the builder — for now.





CONTENT PILLARS YOU WILL OWN

- Fitness & Lifestyle

- Motivational & Mindset

 & Trending Audio Content
