WHAT YOU WILL OWN





BRAND STRATEGY & VISION AMPLIFICATION

- Collaborate directly with the founder to translate vision into a content system that keeps eyes on the brand consistently

- Develop monthly and quarterly content strategies tied to business goals — client acquisition, brand authority, and visibility

- Bring ideas, concepts, and creative directions to the table proactively — pitch before you are asked

- Identify what is performing in the credit repair, real estate, and entrepreneur niches and present actionable insights regularly




 INTELLIGENCE & TREND AWARENESS

- Know what is trending in US pop culture, finance, real estate, and short-form video before it peaks

- Adapt trending 
 formats, audio, and cultural 
nts to the brand's niche quickly and correctly

- Understand timing — a 
 posted three days late does not perform

- Bring the cultural intelligence yourself — we do not educate you on what is funny or what is trending



CONTENT STRATEGY & CALENDAR MANAGEMENT

- Build and manage a monthly content calendar across Instagram, YouTube,
, and TikTok

- Structure content by theme, funnel stage, and optimal posting time — not just by date

- Ensure every week has a clear content objective tied to visibility or conversion

- Track performance weekly and adjust strategy based on data



CONTENT EXECUTION — VIDEO, CAPTION & GRAPHIC

- Produce and deliver 3–7 high-quality Reels, Shorts, or TikTok-style edits per week

- Execute attention-grabbing hooks within the first 1–3 seconds — every time, no exceptions

- Write scroll-stopping captions — hooks, body copy, and CTAs that drive action

- Design carousels, branded 
 content, quote graphics, and educational visuals

- Repurpose long-form content into short, high-impact platform-native clips

- Design thumbnails, apply motion graphics, voiceovers, and text overlays as needed



PLATFORM MANAGEMENT & GROWTH TRACKING

- Schedule and publish content at algorithm-optimized times across all platforms

- Monitor engagement metrics and bring data-driven recommendations to leadership weekly

- Engage with comments and community to boost algorithmic reach

- Consistently add value — every week, every platform, no gaps, no excuses





WHAT YOU MUST BRING





STRATEGIC THINKING — Non-Negotiable

- You think about content as a system for audience growth and client acquisition — not a to-do list

- You can look at a brand and identify what is missing and what should be built next — without being asked

- You understand content funnels and build calendars with awareness, trust, and conversion in mind

- You have a point of view on what works and can defend it with data or platform knowledge



CAPTION WRITING & 
 INTELLIGENCE — Non-Negotiable

- Strong copywriting — captions that hook, hold, and convert

- Deep, current awareness of 
 culture, trending audio, and viral formats in US pop culture and niche communities

- You do not need to be told what is funny — you know, and you know how to apply it to a brand

- When something is trending, you pitch the adaptation before we ask



CONTENT EXECUTION — Elite Level Required

- Expert-level CapCut Pro — hooks, transitions, captions, audio sync, platform-optimized exports

- Additional tools a strong plus: Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva Pro, InShot

- Proven track record of viral or high-performing Reels, Shorts, or TikToks — portfolio required, no exceptions

- Experience with carousels, 
 content, thumbnails, and educational graphics



NICHE KNOWLEDGE

- Working knowledge of credit repair — enough to create accurate educational content without hand-holding

- Familiarity with real estate, renovations, and entrepreneurship content and audiences

- Ability to match tone: high-energy for lifestyle, authoritative for credit repair and real estate education



CONSISTENCY & COMMUNICATION

- Consistent output of 3–7 pieces of content per week without dropping quality

- Experience building a brand presence from the ground up

- Proactive communicator — you surface ideas and flag issues without being chased

- Deadline-driven — on-time delivery is a baseline, not an achievement





THE PERSON WE ARE LOOKING FOR



- A strategic creative — thinks before they build, builds before they post

- Consumes short-form content daily and applies lessons without being prompted

- Can hold a creative conversation, push back when an idea is not strong, and bring alternatives

- Genuinely invested in building a brand long-term — not looking for a quick freelance paycheck

- Treats every post as a direct reflection of the brand and holds their own output to the highest standard





PLATFORMS & TOOLS



Required: CapCut Pro, Instagram/Reels, YouTube/Shorts,

Strong Plus: TikTok, Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, Canva Pro, Later/Buffer/Metricool, Meta Business Suite, ChatGPT/AI Tools, Google Drive





COMPENSATION & GROWTH PATH



Gig / Internship | Remote | $80/month USD | Path to Full-Time at 6 Months



This role starts as a gig and internship arrangement. At the six-month mark, the right candidate will be reviewed for a full-time position with a salary increase. This is a ground-floor opportunity — show up, perform at a high level, and grow with the brand long-term.

2. Which content niche you have the most experience in and one specific result you drove

3. Describe how you would approach building a brand content strategy for a credit repair business from scratch — not just a calendar, but a growth plan



We move fast. The right person will hear from us within days.

- Keep project files organized with clean version control

- Optimize for watch time, click-through, and conversion

- Stay on top of trends across Meta, TikTok, and YouTube

- **3+ years** editing performance ads for e-commerce or info products

- Experience with direct response advertising and VSL structure

- Comfortable with subtitles, animated text, and all social formats (9:16, 4:5, 1:1, 16:9)

- Bonus: experience with the German/DACH market



## Bonus Skills

- Copywriting or storytelling background

- YouTube-style long-form editing

title: Static Ads Designer / Graphic Designer For HaloBlinds
description:
Static Ads Designer / Graphic Designer For HaloBlinds



About HaloBlinds



HaloBlinds is a fast-growing ecommerce brand in the sleep and home improvement space.



We sell premium made-to-measure blackout blinds that create real total darkness without drilling, screws, or permanent damage. Our customers are not just buying blinds. They are buying better sleep, darker rooms, cooler bedrooms, peace for their kids, recovery after night shifts, and a solution that finally stops light leaking through their windows.



We are building HaloBlinds into the leading performance-driven blackout sleep brand in the market.



Now we are looking for a world-class static ads designer who knows how to create direct-response ecommerce creatives that actually convert.



The Role



We are looking for an experienced ecommerce static ads designer / graphic designer who can create high-performing static ads for Meta, Instagram, TikTok, and other paid social channels.



This is not a basic Canva design role.



We need someone who understands:



* Performance marketing

* Direct-response advertising

* Ecommerce psychology

* Ad angles

* Pain points

* Hook testing

* Competitor research

* Offer framing

* Copy and visual hierarchy

* Why people stop scrolling

* Why people click

* Why people buy



You should be able to take a customer pain point and turn it into a clean, sharp, high-converting static ad.



What You Will Work On



You will create static ads for HaloBlinds around angles like:



* Night shift workers who need to sleep during the day

* Parents whose kids wake up too early because of morning light

* People who tried blackout curtains but still have light leaks

* Migraine sufferers who need a pitch-black room

* People using ugly DIY hacks like foil, cardboard, or taped curtains

* Premium made-to-measure blackout without the overpriced custom blind markup

* No-drill installation

* Perfect fit guarantee

* Thermal insulation and cooler bedrooms

* Sleep transformation before and after concepts



We already have structures in place for ad research, customer research, competitor research, pain-point mining, review mining, and finding strong copy angles.



You will not be expected to randomly “make something nice.”



You will be expected to think like a performance creative.



Responsibilities



* Create high-converting static ads for paid social

* Turn research, reviews, competitor ads, and customer pain points into strong visual ad concepts

* Create multiple ad variations per angle

* Write or improve short direct-response copy inside the ad

* Build ads with strong hook, hierarchy, contrast, proof, and CTA

* Recreate winning ad structures from other ecommerce brands and adapt them to HaloBlinds

* Work fast and iterate based on results

* Join video calls to review creatives, strategy, and performance

* Understand what makes an ad scalable, not just beautiful



Requirements



* At least 5 years of experience creating static ads for ecommerce brands

* Proven experience with paid social ads, especially Meta ads

* Strong English

* Comfortable joining video calls

* Strong understanding of direct-response design

* Ability to explain why your ad should work

* Ability to take feedback without ego

* Fast, reliable, and detail-oriented

* Strong eye for premium ecommerce design

* Clear understanding that the goal is not to make pretty images. The goal is to create ads that generate profitable sales.



You Are A Great Fit If



* You have worked with ecommerce brands spending serious money on ads

* You understand ROAS, CPA, CTR, hook rate, and creative testing

* You can look at a competitor ad and understand why it works

* You can create both clean premium ads and aggressive direct-response ads

* You know how to use customer pain points in a visual way

* You care about performance data

* You can bring your own ideas instead of waiting for exact instructions

* You are interested in long-term work with upside



You Are Not A Fit If



* You only make brand graphics, logos, or social posts

* You do not have ecommerce ad experience

* You cannot show real examples of static ads you created

* You are not comfortable on video calls

* You do not speak good English

* You need every small detail explained before starting

* You get offended by feedback

* You only design based on what “looks nice”

* You do not understand paid ads or performance marketing



Compensation



We pay a strong base salary plus large performance bonuses.



The better your static ads perform, the more you can earn.



Bonuses will be based on performance metrics such as:



* Ad spend scaled through your winning creatives

* ROAS

* CPA

* Profitability

* Creative performance compared to other tested ads



We want someone who can grow with the brand and be rewarded properly when their work drives real revenue.



How To Apply



Do not send a generic application.



Applications without a Loom video will be ignored.



Please record a Loom video where you:



* Introduce yourself

* Explain your ecommerce static ad experience

* Show examples of static ads you have created before

* Explain what brands or niches you have worked with

* Talk through one static ad you think would work for HaloBlinds

* Show either a sample ad you would recreate or a new ad concept you would create for HaloBlinds

* Explain the copy angle, the visual angle, and why you think it could convert



The sample can be focused on copy, visual direction, or both.



We want to see how you think.



To prove you read this properly, start your application with:



PITCH BLACK



Final Note



We are looking for someone serious.



HaloBlinds has a big opportunity, strong product-market fit, clear customer pain points, and a system for creative research.



Now we need a designer who can turn that research into static ads that stop the scroll, create belief, and scale profitably.



If that sounds like you, send your Loom and portfolio. Salamat po!

title: BOOKKEEPER — AUSTRALIAN FAMILY OFFICE (Remote)
description:
BOOKKEEPER — AUSTRALIAN FAMILY OFFICE



Part-time remote, from the Philippines. Overlapping Melbourne business hours. Above-market pay. Long-term. Direct to the Principal.



This is a rare bookkeeping role with a kind, well-respected Australian entrepreneur — the kind of person you'll genuinely enjoy working for. You'll be the trusted bookkeeping hand across his family office, his operating businesses, and his investments. No middle layer, no churn, no being treated like a disposable freelancer. A long-term seat at the table, above-market pay, and real responsibility from day one.





Why this role



You'll work directly with the Principal. No project manager in between. Your work goes straight to the person it matters to.



A Principal worth working for. A well-respected Australian entrepreneur with a family office, operating businesses, investments, and family trusts — heavy focus in the health and medical industry. Kind, responsible, and approachable. The kind of client you'll want to do a great job for.



Above-market pay, reliably on time. This is not a budget hire.



Long-term and stable. A trusted bookkeeping hand he plans to keep for years, not a short contract.



Interesting variety. Multiple entities across Australia and New Zealand — investment holding, operating businesses, family trusts, and the Principal's personal accounts. You'll see how a real family office runs.



Real growth. The role can grow into payroll, deeper reporting, and process improvement as the engagement matures.



Respected and trusted. You'll be brought into the inner circle of someone's financial life — that trust is the role.





Role purpose



The Bookkeeper provides hands-on day-to-day bookkeeping in QuickBooks Online — payments and bills, monthly reconciliation, GST/BAS preparation, and consolidated reporting that gives the Principal a clean view across all entities.





The team you'll work with



A small, high-trust circle: the Principal himself, his external Australian accountant (who picks up at EOFY), and you. No layers, no committees. You'll be in regular direct contact with the Principal — a brief call, a chat message, a tidy monthly report. The kind of working relationship that gets better year on year.





Key responsibilities



Day-to-day bookkeeping. Code and enter transactions in QuickBooks Online across multiple entities (debits and credits, expense categorisation, bill entry, receipts capture). Maintain a clean, well-organised chart of accounts for each entity. File and attach supporting documents to transactions. Flag unusual transactions or missing source documents.



Accounts payable and receivable. Process incoming invoices: review, code, enter into QuickBooks, prepare for payment. Action outgoing payments on the Principal's instruction across the relevant entities. Track inter-entity reimbursements (e.g. one entity pays an invoice and recovers from another) and keep the audit trail clean. Maintain supplier records and follow up on missing or incorrect invoices. Issue and track customer invoices where required.



Reconciliation and month-end. Reconcile bank, credit card, and loan accounts monthly across all entities. Resolve discrepancies. Close the books at month-end and produce a tidy trial balance. Maintain a simple month-end checklist so each entity closes consistently.



GST, BAS, and compliance preparation. Prepare GST/BAS workings for the Australian entities; depending on the engagement, either lodge through QuickBooks or hand off to the Principal's accountant. Maintain accurate GST coding throughout the period — not just at BAS time. Keep records audit-ready for the accountant's end-of-financial-year review.



Reporting. Produce monthly P&L and Balance Sheet for each entity. Produce a simple consolidated view across the Principal's interests. Highlight notable movements, large items, or anything that doesn't look right. Respond to ad-hoc queries from the Principal (e.g. "what did we spend on X this quarter").



Engagement and communication. Provide regular updates and reporting. Timely responses and turnarounds. Be available within agreed working hours. Maintain confidentiality across all personal and business financial information.





What we're looking for



We're hiring for craft, judgement, and trust — not a checklist. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



5+ years of hands-on bookkeeping experience, including full reconciliation and month-end close.



Strong working knowledge of QuickBooks Online, including multi-entity setups.



Solid Australian context — confident with Australian GST, BAS, and ATO conventions. This is the one non-negotiable.



Comfortable working across multiple entities and account sets in parallel without losing track.



Strong attention to detail, organised, accurate.



High standard of written and spoken English — able to write a clear, concise update and hold a conversation with the Principal on a call.



Discreet and trustworthy with sensitive personal and business financial information.



Self-motivated; able to work independently without close supervision.



Reliable home internet and a dedicated, professional home workspace.



Nice to have (not required): experience supporting Australian small-business or family-office clients; familiarity with New Zealand GST treatment (one of the entities is NZ-based); payroll experience (the role may expand to include payroll later); experience preparing files for an external accountant to finalise at EOFY; comfort suggesting small process improvements as the engagement matures.





Who you are



You take pride in clean books. You like the quiet satisfaction of a month-end that closes cleanly, a BAS that ties out first time, a chart of accounts that someone else could pick up tomorrow and understand. You're trustworthy with sensitive information. You communicate proactively — no chasing required. And you'd rather have one good long-term client you genuinely respect than five chaotic ones.



If that sounds like you, we'd love to meet you.





How to Apply



Apply directly via OJP. Attach:



1. Your resume (PDF), including the QuickBooks Online environments you've worked in and the countries/tax jurisdictions you've supported.



In your application message, answer these three questions. Short, direct answers — no AI fluff.



1. Australian context. Walk us through how you handled GST coding and BAS prep for an Australian client in your most recent role — coding discipline through the period, what you reconciled at BAS time, and how you handed off to the external accountant. This is essential, not desirable.



2. Multi-entity discipline. How many separate entities (companies / trusts / personal) have you bookkept in QuickBooks Online in parallel, and how do you keep inter-entity reimbursements and the consolidated view clean without losing the audit trail?



3. Logistics. Expected hourly rate in PHP for part-time hours (tell us the hours per week you're targeting), earliest start date, and confirm you can overlap Melbourne, Australia business hours each working day.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

title: Meta Ads VSL Editor
description:
OVERVIEW

We are looking for a skilled VSL (Video Sales Letter) Editor who can craft long-form, high-converting video content for e-commerce and DTC brands. This is not a short-form or social media role — you will own the full VSL production pipeline, turning raw scripts, footage, and voiceovers into polished sales videos that drive measurable revenue outcomes.

CORE RESPONSIBILITIES

• VSL Production: Edit full-length VSLs (typically 5–30 minutes) from provided scripts, voiceovers, and b-roll footage — structured to maximise viewer retention and purchase intent.

• DR Structure & Flow: Apply proven Direct Response frameworks: strong hook and problem identification in the opening segment, benefit-stacking through the body, and a high-urgency close with clear CTA.

• Visual Storytelling: Build compelling visual narratives that support the sales script — using text overlays, callouts, product close-ups, testimonial segments, and supporting graphics to reinforce key selling points.

• Audio & Pacing: Master voiceover pacing, background music layering, and sound design to maintain engagement throughout long-form content. Silence and timing are as important as visuals.

• Iteration Based on Data: Produce A/B testing variants (different hooks, CTAs, segment reordering) based on performance feedback — view-through rate, drop-off points, and conversion data.

• Platform Optimisation: Export and format VSLs for web-hosted sales pages, YouTube pre-roll, and
 funnels. Understand the difference between a hosted VSL and a paid ad placement.

• Asset Management: Maintain organised project files, source footage, and export versions for handoff to media buyers and funnel builders.



MUST-HAVES

• Proven VSL editing portfolio — at least 2–3 examples of long-form sales videos (not short-form ads or brand content) with demonstrated conversion outcomes.

• Advanced proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or Final Cut Pro, with clean, well-structured timelines.

• Deep understanding of Direct Response marketing: you know what a hook, a benefit stack, a proof section, and a close look like — and how to pace them visually.

• Experience working with voiceover-led content and synchronising visuals to narration beats.

• Comfort with text-heavy editing — callouts, chapter titles, emphasis overlays, and on-screen proof elements (screenshots, testimonials, stats).

• Performance mindset — you treat data (watch time, drop-off, CVR) as creative direction, not criticism.

• Reliable fast turnaround: first cuts within 48 hours; revisions within 24 hours.



BONUS SKILLS

• Experience with animated explainer-style segments or whiteboard/kinetic typography within VSLs.

• Proficiency in After Effects for lower thirds, animated callouts, and motion graphics.

• Familiarity with VSL hosting platforms (Wistia, Vimeo, ClickFunnels embedded video).

• Understanding of funnel architecture — how a VSL fits into a sales page, order bump, and upsell flow.

• Experience editing for supplement, info-product, or high-ticket e-commerce VSL formats.

title: Lead Generation Specialist (Strategy to Build) — Australian Clients (Remote, PH)
description:
Full-time or part-time remote, from the Philippines. Australian business hours. Above-market pay for the right person. Long-term. Flexible terms to suit your situation.



We work with a range of Australian businesses that need a proper lead generation system built, not just someone to send messages. We're looking for people who can design the system, set it up, and run it: pick the channels, build the lists, stand up the tools and automation, write the sequences, and turn it into booked meetings. We're building a pool of strong specialists to match with these clients as the work comes up.



This is for people who can own lead generation end to end. If you've built an outbound system from a blank page and made it produce meetings, we want to hear from you.



WHY THIS ROLE

Build it your way. You're not slotting into someone else's broken process. You design the lead gen system and you own how it works.



Real Australian clients. Established businesses that want results, not one-off gigs that vanish after a week.

Flexible terms. Part-time or full-time depending on what suits you. Tell us your availability and we'll work with it.

Above-market pay for the right person. We pay well for people who can build something that actually produces leads, and we pay on time.



Long-term and stable. We want people we can place for the long run.



Variety. Different clients and industries, so the work stays interesting and your skills keep growing.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

The exact mix depends on the client, but the core is the same: build the lead generation system and make it work.

Strategy. Understand the client's offer, target market, and ideal customer. D
 which channels to run (cold
, LinkedIn, phone, or a mix), define the targeting, and set the outreach approach and messaging angle.



Build and set up. Stand up the tools and infrastructure: CRM, outreach platform,
 domains and warm-up, data and enrichment sources, tracking. Build accurate prospect lists from the target market, research decision-makers, and find and verify contact details.



Implement and automate. Write the sequences and scripts, set up the automation, and get the system running. Wire up the steps so leads move cleanly from first contact to booked meeting.



Run and improve. Manage the day-to-day outreach, book the meetings, qualify leads against the client's criteria, and keep the CRM clean. Watch the numbers, test what's not working, and tune the system over time.



Report. Outreach sent, conversations started, meetings booked, leads qualified, and what you changed to improve them.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're hiring for people who've actually built outbound systems, not just worked a list someone handed them. If most of the below describes you, please apply.



A track record of building a lead generation system end to end: strategy, setup, implementation, and results. Ideally for Western or Australian clients.



Hands-on with the tools. CRMs and outreach or prospecting platforms (for example HubSpot, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, Apollo, Instantly, Smartlead, Clay, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, or similar), plus
 deliverability basics (domains, warm-up, DNS records).

Comfortable with appointment setting yourself. You can run the outreach and book the meetings, not only design the process.

Clear, confident English, written and spoken.



Organised and self-directed. You can build something from a blank page and keep it running without being managed closely.

Reliable home internet and a quiet workspace.



Nice to have (not required): automation and no-code tools (Zapier, Make, n8n), data scraping and enrichment (Clay, PhantomBuster), copywriting for cold outreach, and experience across more than one channel.



WHO YOU ARE

You're a builder. Handed a client with no pipeline and no system, you know where to start and you've done it before. You like the puzzle of figuring out who to target and how to reach them, then building the machine that does it at volume. You keep your pipeline tidy and your follow-ups on time, and you'd rather own a system for a good long-term client than execute someone else's scripts.



If that sounds like you, apply below.



HOW TO APPLY

Apply directly via OJP. Attach your resume (PDF). In your application message, answer the questions below. Short, direct, specific answers. No AI-written fluff. Applications that skip the questions won't be progressed.



A system you built. Describe one lead generation system you built from scratch. What was the client's offer and target market, what channels did you choose and why, and what did the finished system actually produce (meetings or leads per week or month)?



1. Strategy to setup. Walk us from blank page to live. How do you d
 who to target and which channels to run, and what do you set up first when standing up a new outbound system?



2. The stack. List the tools you used to build your last system (CRM, outreach platform, data and enrichment, automation). Which do you know best, and what would you set up for a brand-new client tomorrow?



3. Deliverability. If you run cold
: how do you set up domains and warm-up, and what do you do to keep
s landing in the inbox? If you don't do cold
, tell us which channel you build around instead and why.



4. Numbers. In your last system, roughly how many prospects did you contact a week, how many conversations did that start, and how many meetings did it book? What did you change to improve those numbers?



5. Appointment setting. Are you comfortable running the outreach and booking meetings yourself, not just designing the process? Give one example of a meeting you booked from a cold start.



6. Logistics. Your availability (part-time or full-time, and which hours you can cover against Australian business hours), expected monthly pay in PHP, and your earliest start date.



Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. Strong fits go to a short video interview.

- set up collections, pages, navigation, footer, policies, and basic store details

- make the store look clean, trustworthy, and professional

- check your own work on desktop and mobile before delivery



Who We Want



We prefer someone with experience in Shopify dropshipping stores, Google Shopping, Google Merchant Center, or GMC-ready store builds.



GMC knowledge is a plus, but not required. If you are strong at building Shopify stores and can learn fast, that is also good.



Important: We need someone who can use AI practically for ecommerce work. Not only chatting with ChatGPT, but using AI to speed up product importing, product copy, product organization, and store-building tasks.



Workload



- 3–5 focused hours per workday

- Long-term role for the right person

- You must be able to work independently and communicate clearly



How to Apply



Start your application with the word HORIZON so we know you read the full post.



Please answer only these questions:



1. Send 3 examples of Shopify stores you personally built or helped build.

2. What exactly did you do on those stores?

3. Do you have your own ChatGPT subscription?

4. How many focused hours per day are you available?

5. What is your expected monthly salary for 3–5 hours per day?

6. Tell us shortly about yourself: who are you, where do you live, how old are you, and what is your work experience?



Final Note



We are looking for someone reliable, independent, and practical. If you can build clean Shopify stores, use AI properly, follow an SOP, and deliver consistent work without constant hand-holding, this can become a long-term role.

title: Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions
description:

Mega Land Pros is a leading real estate (land) investment firm that is focused on acquiring and managing real estate assets. Our highly experienced team specializes in identifying opportunities, closing transactions efficiently, and delivering exceptional results.  By combining industry expertise with advanced technology, data-driven market analysis, and streamlined systems, we identify investment opportunities and deliver fast, efficient transactions.



Job Description:

We are seeking a detail-oriented individual to join our team as a Cold Caller/Real Estate Acquisitions representative. This role will be critical in acquiring and evaluating land deals, analyzing comparable properties, researching markets, and gathering data.



This is a long-term, full-time position. You will be working directly with our U.S. team during eastern business hours.



Responsibilities:

Qualifications:

• Experience with real estate, specifically vacant land acquisitions and land pricing preferred

• High energy with excellent communication and interpersonal skills

• Takes full ownership

• Follows checklists

• Meets deadlines

• Communicate clearly

• Ability to learn and work independently

• Proficient in Excel

• Dependable internet connection and a quiet work environment



Soft Skills needed:

• Strong and fluent in speaking and writing English

• Detail orientated

• Kind and empathetic



Working Hours:

Pay:

Why Join Us:

title: Experienced Supply Chain Manager for US Fashion Dropshipping Store
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE



We are looking for an experienced, independent and hands-on Supply Chain Manager for a fast-growing US fashion dropshipping store.

This is not an entry-level position.

You will be fully responsible for the supply chain process from the 
nt an order is placed until it is successfully delivered to the customer.

You must be able to work independently, stay extremely close to the data in our fixed Google Drive documents and Google Sheets, and communicate directly and firmly with our supplier whenever orders are delayed, unprocessed or not moving correctly.

This role also includes all ParcelPanel and tracking-related checks. You will not only review order data—you will actively identify problems, follow up and make sure they are resolved.



ABOUT THE STORE



We operate a fashion dropshipping store focused on customers in the United States.

The store is scaling quickly, so order processing, fulfillment speed, tracking accuracy and delivery performance are extremely important.

All orders must be processed within 24 hours, preferably faster.

Our target is for every order to be delivered within a maximum of 10 business days from the order date.

You will work with fixed Google Drive documents, Google Sheets, SOPs and supply chain workflows.



YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES



• Monitor every order from placement until final delivery

• Make sure all new orders are processed within 24 hours, preferably faster

• Make sure no paid orders remain unfulfilled or forgotten

• Check daily whether orders have been correctly sent to the supplier

• Monitor fulfillment, tracking updates and delivery progress

• Perform daily ParcelPanel checks

• Identify orders that are delayed, stuck, returned, expired or not moving

• Understand and act on all important tracking statuses

• Recognize that “Shipment Information Received” means the carrier has received the shipping information, but the parcel has not necessarily been physically shipped yet

• Follow up immediately when tracking does not show real movement

• Make sure every order is delivered within a maximum of 10 business days whenever possible

• Escalate delayed or high-risk orders before they become customer complaints or disputes

• Keep all fixed Google Drive documents and Google Sheets complete and updated daily

• Accurately document processing dates, shipment dates, tracking progress, delays and delivery dates

• Monitor supplier inventory and product availability

• Check whether products and variants are still available before they create fulfillment problems

• Identify out-of-stock products, unavailable variants and inventory risks

• Communicate stock issues to the relevant tea
mbers so listings can be adjusted or paused

• Communicate directly with the supplier about processing, inventory, tracking and delivery problems

• Follow up repeatedly until supplier issues are fully resolved

• Be professional but firm when the supplier is not meeting agreed requirements

• Hold the supplier accountable for processing and delivery performance

• Report recurring supplier, product, shipping-line or tracking problems

• Coordinate with the Customer Support Manager when an order issue affects a customer

• Help prevent refunds, disputes and chargebacks caused by fulfillment or delivery problems

• Suggest improvements to supply chain workflows and tracking sheets

• Take full ownership of everything related to supply chain and fulfillment



YOUR MAIN OBJECTIVE



Your job is not simply to check tracking numbers.

Your responsibility is to make sure:

• Every paid order is processed

• No order is forgotten or left unfulfilled

• Orders are processed within 24 hours

• Tracking shows real movement

• Delays are identified and handled early

• The supplier is followed up and held accountable

• Delivery times remain within our required target

• Google Sheets and backend records are always accurate

• Customer complaints, refunds and disputes caused by shipping problems are minimized



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



We are looking for an A-player who:

• Takes full ownership of the complete supply chain

• Does not wait to be told what to do

• Identifies problems before they become serious

• Follows up until every issue is resolved

• Is confident enough to communicate firmly with suppliers

• Is highly accurate with Google Sheets and backend data

• Can manage a substantial order volume without losing control

• Understands the effect of fulfillment and delivery performance on customer satisfaction, disputes and payment accounts



REQUIREMENTS



• Direct experience with e-commerce dropshipping supply chain management

• Previous experience as a Supply Chain Manager, Senior Supply Chain Representative, Fulfillment Manager or similar role

• At least 3 months of experience working for one dropshipping store that consistently generated at least $100,000 per month

• Proven experience monitoring a substantial daily order volume

• Direct experience managing orders from placement until delivery

• Experience communicating and following up with dropshipping suppliers

• Experience with supplier inventory and product availability management

• Experience identifying and resolving unfulfilled orders

• Experience with ParcelPanel or a similar tracking platform

• Strong understanding of tracking statuses and real shipment movement

• Strong experience with Shopify

• Strong experience with Google Drive and Google Sheets

• Comfortable working with fixed SOPs, sheets and KPIs

• Strong written English

• Able to communicate independently and firmly with suppliers

• Available for a full-time, long-term position

• Highly accurate, proactive, organized and solution-oriented



STRONG ADVANTAGES



• Experience with US fashion or apparel dropshipping

• Experience with ParcelPanel

• Experience working with Chinese dropshipping suppliers or agents

• Experience monitoring order-to-delivery times

• Experience reducing late deliveries and unfulfilled orders

• Experience managing inventory availability across listings and suppliers

• Experience coordinating with customer support teams

• Experience creating or improving supply chain workflows and sheets



WORKING CONDITIONS



• Full-time position

• Long-term opportunity

• Remote work

• US fashion dropshipping store

• Hands-on supply chain role

• Fixed Google Drive and Google Sheets workflows

• Clear SOPs and measurable KPIs

• Daily supplier communication and order monitoring

• High level of independence and responsibility



COMPENSATION



$4-$5 per hour, flexible depending on experience and proven results.



HOW TO APPLY



Send the following via WhatsApp to:


Your CV

A link to a short application video of no more than 5-7 minutes



Please answer the following questions in your video:

1. Briefly introduce yourself and explain your previous experience in e-commerce dropshipping and supply chain management.

2. Which dropshipping store did you work for that consistently generated at least $100,000 per month, how long did you work there, and what were your exact supply chain responsibilities?

3. Why did you leave your most recent role, and why are you interested in this Supply Chain Manager position?

4. Explain how you make sure every paid order is processed, shipped and tracked correctly, with no unfulfilled orders being forgotten.

5. How do you manage supplier inventory and product availability, and what do you do when a product or variant becomes unavailable?

6. What does the tracking status “Shipment Information Received” mean, and what action would you take if this status does not change?

7. How do you monitor ParcelPanel and identify orders that are delayed, stuck, returned or not showing real movement?

8. Describe a situation where a supplier was not meeting processing or delivery requirements. How did you address the supplier and resolve the issue?

9. Are you currently working for another company? If yes, explain your current schedule and whether you are genuinely available for a full-time position.

10. Rate your problem-solving ability from 1 to 5, followed by only one word that describes you. Do not explain your answer.



IMPORTANT



Do not apply if you have no direct dropshipping supply chain experience.

Do not apply if you have never worked for a dropshipping store consistently generating at least $100,000 per month.

Do not apply if you only have basic order-processing experience and have never independently managed suppliers, fulfillment and tracking.

Applications without a CV and application video will not be considered.



Start your WhatsApp message with:

SCM A-PLAYER
